title: Did Prince Rong Win His Wife Back Today?
author: Tang Li Tang
synopsis:
(Dog-blooded romance novel! Do not complain if this is not to your taste!) 
When Gu Lingzhao was twelve years old, she met the most untamable Ninth Prince in the capital. Yet, that person never showed his vicious or fierce side in front of her. 

The fierce, ferocious tiger retracted its claws and transformed into an obedient civet cat, causing Gu Lingzhao to completely lose her bearings in the love trap he wove for her. 

It wasn't until her wedding night, when the Gu family suddenly suffered a calamity, that amidst the chaos she finally heard Ye Jing's truest thoughts. 

It turned out that everything, absolutely everything, was a sham. 'Your affection for me, your love at first sight, were all fake... All these years, everything between us was just acting on the spot?' 'Yes.' Ye Jing's answer back then...

chapters.title: Sudden Change on the Wedding Night
chapters.content:
"My Lady, how could you lift your own wedding veil on the day of your grand wedding? The Ninth Prince hasn't arrived yet!" Nanqing exclaimed, unable to believe that her mistress, who was always demure and observant of propriety, would tear off her red wedding veil by herself on her wedding night.

The bright dragon-and-phoenix wedding candles on the candle holder reflected the bride's peerless and flawless countenance. The vibrant bridal attire made the bride's skin look superior to snow with a swan-like slender neck, and the hollowed-out gold, threaded, and hawksbill-shell phoenix crown glittered with a brilliant array of colors, with the massive Dongzhu pearl on top of the crown being a symbol of prominent nobility.

Gu Lingzhao gazed at the golden-embroidered red silk veil in her hand, her delicate eyebrows slightly knitted, and a flash of regret passed through her eyes that were as clear as water. "How could I not know that this is not in accordance with propriety."

"Then why did My Lady do it?"

"Something may have happened to the Marquis's Mansion." Gu Lingzhao held a crumpled piece of paper in her left hand, which bore just a few sparse lines: The Xuanping Marquis's Mansion, colluding with the enemy and committing treason, in danger!

The bridal chamber was as bright as day, and Gu Lingzhao had been able to clearly see the contents of the note even under her veil earlier. Just a single glance made her heart plummet violently.

"Aside from the two of you, who else has gotten close to me before this?" This note had been suddenly shoved into her hand just as she entered the doorway.

Nanyu and Nanqing wore hesitant expressions. After kowtowing to heaven and earth in the main hall, they had been surrounded by throngs of people all the way back; the people around them had simply been too numerous.

"That's right, why did those maidservants and mamis just now all disappear?" Nanqing said, realizing it belatedly. During an imperial prince's grand wedding, how could the surroundings possibly be so quiet?

Nanyu had a steadier personality. Seeing that Gu Lingzhao's complexion was poor, she immediately lowered herself and gently consoled her, "My Lady, do not panic. The Marquis's character is upright and unyielding, and the Gu clan has held ducal titles for generations; how could they be saddled with such a charge? In this servant's view, it is undoubtedly someone trying to stir up trouble on My Lady's wedding day."

Gu Lingzhao was naturally able to judge that the person who passed this note to her was an enemy rather than a friend, and the abnormal circumstances around her were not enough to make her lose her composure. However, the four characters "colluding with the enemy and committing treason" were truly making her head spin, and the more she thought about it, the more her scalp tinged with numbness. She tried her best to remain calm, but her slender fingers trembled uncontrollably; she could not wait!

"I am going to find A-Jing!" Gu Lingzhao raised her hand to remove the heavy headwear. "Having bowed to heaven and earth, the rites are complete. I will be willful just this once; A-Jing will not blame me."

When people are panicked and at a loss, they will surely seek out the person they can rely on the most.

Just like Gu Lingzhao at this moment, she no longer had the heart to deduce the intentions of the person behind the secret letter. Right here and right now, she only urgently wanted to see Ye Jing.

Inside the study of the estate, a strategist who had hurried over stood before the desk with a heavy expression, carefully weighing his words.

"Ninth Highness, do you know about the upheaval at the Xuanping Marquis's Mansion tonight?"

"I have already received the news." Ye Jing was sitting in a rosewood chair, his red wedding robes not yet changed out of.

"First Highness sent me here in the middle of the night precisely for this matter. The decree from the palace came too suddenly, and it is the grave charge of treason and colluding with the enemy; His Majesty's thoughts are truly hard to guess."

"Just tell me directly what Eldest Brother sent you to convey." Ye Jing's gaze was deep and dark, his gloomy expression starkly contradicting his wedding attire.

A trace of helplessness flashed through Lu Qin's heart; the current situation was indeed far too sudden.

The Gu family were the most loyal supporters of the Third Prince's faction.

As for having Ye Jing approach Gu Lingzhao back then, it was merely an offhand jest by Ye Zhang, whose original intention was just to feel that Ye Jing, having just returned from Cangsu Mountain, was too idle and stirred up trouble in the capital every day, giving him a headache.

Who could have anticipated that the young Ye Jing would actually take it seriously, happily accepting the mission with an entirely jubilant expression of wanting to share burdens for his elder brother.

With Ye Jing's restless temperament, he had actually genuinely stuck by that eldest miss of the Gu family for a full five years, accompanying her to view flowers and snow, boil tea and listen to the rain, and even doing all sorts of impulsive and protective things for the beauty. The appearance of having deep roots of love made it almost difficult for others to tell if it was real or fake.

Even among their own people, no one dared to guarantee that Ye Jing could emerge unscathed from this matter.

This was why Ye Zhang had sent Lu Qin over in the middle of the night. Failing to leverage the Gu family's strength was already a pity, and they absolutely must not invite further disaster because of this matter!

Thinking of this, Lu Qin gritted his teeth, lowered his head, and continued, "This time, the Gu family is likely to suffer some tribulation. I ask that the Ninth Highness please not act rashly. Eldest Highness has already given orders that he will find a way to maneuver around this; as long as you keep a low profile during this period, the Gu family's sins will never tarnish you, Ninth Highness."

Seeing that Ye Jing remained silent, Lu Qin remembered this Highness's fiery and uncontrollable temper, and a wave of emptiness arose in his heart; he truly did not dare to withdraw just like that.

"Ninth Highness, your marrying the Gu family was originally to balance the Gu family's influence. Do not forget what you promised Eldest Highness back then. The severity of the current situation is unlike the past, and Eldest Highness hopes you will prepare yourself, when necessary, you must be decisive!"

Ye Jing glared at him fiercely, cold light shooting from his eyes. Just when Lu Qin thought Ye Jing was going to smash the teacup on the table onto his head, he heard the other suddenly let out a laugh. "I said back then, she is just a woman. Imperial Elder Brother needed me to marry her, so I went to marry her. For Imperial Elder Brother's great cause, these are nothing difficult. Master Lu need not be nervous; I know my limits. Imperial Elder Brother already finds it no easy task to deal with Ye Tang and Ye Xuand, so I will not add to the chaos."

Hearing this, Lu Qin let out a truly huge sigh of relief, his voice even becoming much lighter. "Your hard work all these years has been seen by Consort De and Eldest Highness. Once this storm passes, Consort De will surely seek another good match for Your Highness, and will not let you suffer grievances in vain."

Ye Jing lowered his eyes, his fingers gently twisting the exquisite pattern on his sleeve. A pair of phoenix eyes lacked their usual soaring brightness, and his whole person was enshrouded in a sense of desolate coldness.

"Your Highness need not overly worry either. The Third Prince and Fourth Prince have been at loggerheads for a long time, and the Xuanping Marquis's Mansion's disaster this time is clearly the Fourth Prince's doing. Those two households are bound to have a round of plotting and fighting, and who wins and who loses remains to be seen."

"I will keep Imperial Elder Brother's instructions in mind. The hour is late, Master Lu should return."

Hearing the impatience in Ye Jing's voice, Lu Qin sensibly bowed and said, "May Your Highness also take care of your health and rest early. This official takes his leave."

Ye Jing wore little expression, merely nodding.

He could hear the sound of Lu Qin's footsteps leaving the study. At the very moment the door-pushing sound echoed, a sudden gust of cold wind seemed to pour into the room. Ye Jing's desk clearly did not face the door, yet the cool wind still blew his goosebumps to stand on end. May was the beginning of summer, but the sudden arrival of coldness made Ye Jing wonder momentarily if heaven and earth had disordered the seasons.

"Gu... ahem, commoner Lu Qin greets the Imperial Princess Consort." Although Lu Qin's voice carried respect, it was devoid of panic.

The bright red lanterns decorated for the wedding under the eaves radiated warmth, yet the bride standing outside the door wearing her bridal robes currently had hollow eyes. The vibrant red bridal gown cast a deathly pale reflection on Gu Lingzhao's face, which at first glance even carried a somewhat chilling aura.

chapters.title: Interrogation
chapters.content:
She, who had always abided by propriety, ignored Lu Qin's greeting and walked with stiff steps across the threshold of the study.

Gu Lingzhao entered just in time to meet Ye Jing's gaze. The man sitting composedly behind the desk had a very calm expression, his cold gaze showing not the slightest bit of evasion.

Gu Lingzhao opened her mouth, but could not emit any sound. Coldness surged in waves within her heart, and the surroundings were frighteningly silent, yet she felt her ears were filled with harsh, piercing noises, as if her soul itself were wailing.

She must be having a nightmare; otherwise, how could she have heard such terrifying words from Ye Jing's mouth? Her A-Jing, the one who dared to recklessly create a massive uproar at the Princess's Mansion without regard for consequences just to stand up for her; the one who, to win the approval of her father, stood upon the martial arts stage at age seventeen and risked a broken arm to claim victory; he had saved her many times, treated her well day after day and year after year, and cherished her. Yet today, on their wedding day, he told her that all of it was fake, nothing more than a long-laid trap, and that the person she loved with all her heart was merely after her family background.

Ye Jing remained silent. In the end, it was Gu Lingzhao who spoke first. "What you said just now... what did it mean? What was meant by balancing the Gu family's influence?"

Her tone was both fragile and helpless, entirely devoid of the righteous confidence of one interrogating a wrongdoer. Even though she had already read the expression on Ye Jing's face, Gu Lingzhao still refused to believe it. She desperately hoped the man before her would give her an explanation; as long as it was a bitter difficulty spoken from his own mouth, she could persuade herself to forget the conversation she had just overheard.

"Why won't you speak? Ye Jing?"

"It means just what you heard." Ye Jing closed his eyes and took a deep breath, perhaps because there were no longer any misgivings to weigh on him, or because there was no need to rack his brains for excuses, or perhaps out of a lingering shred of conscience that made him unwilling to continue spinning falsehoods. In any case, right in front of Gu Lingzhao, he truly could not fabricate any blind lies.

"So, you marrying me, acting as though you loved me, coaxing me with joy day after month... was just to lull my father and elder brother into lowering their guard, so you could then use me to drive a wedge between the Gu family and the Third Prince, allowing you and your true imperial brother to sit back and reap the profits of the fisherman?" Gu Lingzhao forced herself to stand firm, tears washing her eyes to an exceptional clarity. Facing such a clean pair of eyes, Ye Jing could not utter a single word of refutation.

"Your affection for me, your love at first sight, were all fake. All these years, everything between us was just acting on the spot..." For the first time, Gu Lingzhao hated her rational thoughts. Those terrifying facts, the truths of the past she had failed to notice, all manifested entirely within her mind in a single instant.

"In the end, in your eyes, I was actually just a task assigned to you by your Eldest Imperial Brother, wasn't I?"

"Yes." For a brief moment, Ye Jing did not want to answer, as if something deep within his heart had been violently yanked, and a voice told him not to lay his cards on the table. However, Gu Lingzhao's bleeding accusations left him no room to gloss things over. She was, after all, a daughter of the Gu family; given her talent and insight, as long as her mind was clear, hearing those few words was truly enough to deduce the full origin of the matter.

"You..." Gu Lingzhao had been streaming with tears unawares. She pressed her hands hard against her chest, as if doing so could delay the agony of heartbreak.

Ye Jing stood up with a cold expression, his voice devoid of fluctuation as he said, "Since you have married me, I will naturally protect your safety. As long as you are obedient, no matter what happens outside, your status will never be shaken."

Gu Lingzhao looked as though she had heard something utterly absurd. She asked in a daze, "So, am I supposed to be profoundly grateful to Your Highness? His Highness truly has wonderful methods... committing the deeds of an evil ghost, yet wishing to have a statue erected for worship?"

"Zhaozhao," Ye Jing frowned deeply as he looked at her, "you have no other choice."

Gu Lingzhao powerlessly closed her eyes.

That's right, she had already married Ye Jing, married into the royal family; how could she possibly have any other choice? Her father and eldest brother would indeed stand unconditionally behind her, but right now the Xuanping Marquis's Mansion was in an uncertain plight and unable to protect itself...

Gu Lingzhao desperately wanted to take the vase beside her and smash it against Ye Jing's head. She wanted to ask him if he had any heart at all; they had known each other for years, going through life and death together during that time. Throughout those years of companionship, he had repeatedly claimed to love her, swearing to marry only her for the rest of his life, and the sincerity that had flashed in those eyes was still vivid in her mind.

How could he tell her that all of this was fake? How could he have the audacity to hurt her so matter-of-factly!

Yet right now, she couldn't even bitterly curse his actions. She dared not; she dared not completely break ties with Ye Jing.

At the most difficult moment for the Xuanping Marquis's Mansion, she could not push Ye Zhang and Ye Jing onto the opposite side of the mansion either. She could not let her own momentary wilfulness plunge the mansion's situation from bad to worse. Swallowing a mouthful of bitter grievance deep into her heart, Gu Lingzhao could feel the churning upheaval in her chest, pain spreading from her internal organs all the way to her limbs, even making her fingertips ache.

A shadow cast downward. Before she knew it, Ye Jing was already standing before Gu Lingzhao. He raised a hand, wanting to wipe the tears from her face, a gesture both familiar and natural. But this time, she directly turned her face away to avoid his touch. Ye Jing's arm stiffened, and then he decisively pulled his hand back.

"The hour is late. Shall I accompany you back to your room?"

"No need!"

Gu Lingzhao took two steps back, then curtsied to Ye Jing. Amidst the shifting winds and clouds, she had already gathered her emotions, saying with lowered eyes and submissive demeanor, "His Highness is busy with affairs, and this concubine ought not to disturb you. I shall take my leave now."

Ye Jing nodded and uttered a single "very well." He stood calmly in place, watching as Gu Lingzhao stepped out of the study's grand doors, her bridal robes still glowing brilliantly under the illumination of the night lanterns.

I don't know how much time passed, but Ye Jing maintained a single posture the entire time. He could not feel the soreness in his legs, only silently calculating in his heart that by now Gu Lingzhao should have returned to the Mingzhao Pavilion, and Lu Qin should have long since left the prince's residence.

Ye Jing moved his legs and walked toward the desk. In a flash of emotional turbulence, without any warning, Ye Jing suddenly delivered a palm strike straight onto the yellow pearwood desk. His formidable internal energy instantly shattered the desk into four or five pieces. The next moment, Ye Jing turned around and kicked over the curio stand on the side, which was laden with antique porcelain vases. The heart-stopping sound of the wooden rack crashing to the floor and the porcelain shattering echoed through the air. The guards outside the study listened to the tremendous noises continuously emanating from within, yet not a single one dared to utter a sound or enter to dissuade him.

"Mushui!" After a long while, an order finally came from inside the study.

Hearing the call, Mushui pushed the door open promptly. "This subordinate is here!"

Ye Jing stood alone in the room, the devastation scattered across the floor making Mushui's heart skip a beat.

"Starting today, no guards in the estate are permitted to leave; all are to stand by on standby within the residence. Without my command, the people of the Empress and Eldest Brother are not allowed to enter or exit at will."

"Understood, this subordinate obeys."

"Mm, go. Wait!"

"Does Your Highness have other instructions?"

"Just now... when she walked out..."

"The Princess Consort was indeed crying bitterly just now. Would Your Highness prefer to go take a look?" Mushui answered cautiously.

Ye Jing gazed earnestly at his most trusted confidant, his voice flat and cold. "There's nothing to see. Didn't we anticipate this kind of scenario long ago?"

chapters.title: My Name is Ye Jing
chapters.content:
Ye Jing had been sent to Mount Cangsu at a very tender age, and was not brought back to the capital until he was in his early teens.

At that time in the capital, there were three intensely sought-after imperial princes.

Among them, the Third Prince, Ye Tang, was as bright as the breeze and the moon, winning the hearts of the people most of all. At a young age, he had already gained a widespread reputation for virtue, and there was no shortage of various clans and factions in the capital secretly placing their bets on him.

As for the Fourth Prince, Ye Xuan, he was the legitimate son left behind by the late Empress. Because of his status as the legitimate son, he was supported by a faction of veteran officials in the capital. At the same time, the Emperor's affection for this son far surpassed that of all the others; excessive pampering had resulted in the Fourth Prince's eccentric, gloomy, and ruthless temperament. He was accustomed to raising his chin to look down on all living beings, holding none of the surrounding brothers and sisters in any regard.

Then there was the First Prince, Ye Zhang, born of Consort De. As the eldest imperial son, Ye Zhang had always acted prudently and flawlessly, yet in this struggle for the legitimate succession, he appeared somewhat mediocre.

In terms of status, he fell short of Ye Xuan; in terms of charm, he fell short of Ye Tang, and those in the court willing to support him were even fewer.

As biological brothers born of the same mother, Ye Jing naturally was unwilling to let Ye Zhang fall into an inferior position, and he spent all day pondering how he could contribute to his elder brother.

Thus, he set his sights on the most prominent young lady of the Gu family in the capital at that time.

The Gu family was originally an aristocratic clan, and its head, Marquis Xuanping Gu Yi, had served as an official at a young age with outstanding political achievements, his disciples spreading across various regions; he could be called the leader of the scholar-bureaucrat clans. The Marquis's younger brother, Gu Sheng, was a fiercely loyal general appointed by the imperial court, holding the military power of the southeast and guarding a regional border.

At that time, every estate in the capital shared a common understanding: the eldest young lady of the Gu family was in no way inferior in status to a prince or princess.

It could be said that when Ye Jing first returned to the capital in his youth, the very first unfamiliar name he heard was Gu Lingzhao.

"Since the daughter of the Gu family is so important, if I were to marry her, would I be able to lend a helping hand to my elder brother?" Ye Jing was quite young back then, and his eyes were full of admiration as he looked at Ye Zhang.

"Haha, our A-Jing is so young, yet he is already thinking of sharing his elder brother's worries. Truly a good lad! The Marquis of Xuanping's daughter marrying Third Brother would indeed be disadvantageous to me. You have reminded me, though, if she could marry you..." Ye Zhang's expression grew serious. "If you can marry Gu Lingzhao, no matter how one looks at it, it is beneficial to us. Gu Lingzhao is the Marquis's only daughter; even if we cannot gain the Gu family's assistance, when swords clash and blades flash, the Marquis certainly will not completely disregard this connection. You are of an age similar to hers, and right now, we are not the only ones unwilling to see the Gu family and Ye Tang form a marriage alliance. Perhaps this is indeed a good opportunity. Only..."

"Only what?"

"The ties between the Gu family and Third Brother run far too deep. The Marquis was once Third Brother's instructing mentor, and the eldest young master of the Gu family accompanied Third Brother in their youth like brothers. I'm afraid that Gu Lingzhao has long since been involved with Third Brother..."

"What does that matter? His Majesty has not yet issued an imperial decree for marriage. The deeper their ties are, the more helpful the eldest young lady of the Gu family will be to us."

Watching the eagerness in Ye Jing's eyes, Ye Zhang kindly reminded him, "The eldest young lady of the Gu family is known as the supreme beauty of the capital. A-Jing, you must not end up having your heart and soul stolen away by a mere woman in the end."

"How could that be? Just a woman." Ye Jing was dismissive; he despised the affected and artificial demeanor of infatuated men and resentful women the most.

The current Ye Jing still held this belief. Those of the imperial family were destined to be cold-blooded and detached, where even flesh-and-blood kin might turn swords against one another. All benevolence and compassion could potentially become sharp blades turning to pierce one's own body. What was love? He had never deeply pondered or investigated it; those shy, yearning sentiments of young maidens were things whose significance he simply had no way of comprehending.

Gu Lingzhao straightened her back and walked back to the Mingzhao Pavilion. Along the way, the eaves and corners of the roofs were draped with red silks and red lanterns. She walked with hurried steps, unwilling to dwell on the disparity, yet she paused and looked up only when she reached the threshold of the Mingzhao Pavilion. This was the name Ye Jing had given it. Back then, he had embraced her from behind, lowering his head to whisper softly in her ear. His voice was pleasant and tinged with excitement, his gentle breath turning her earlobes bright red. At that time, she felt that every single character in the three words "Mingzhao Pavilion" contained Ye Jing's love for her.

Tears slipped down silently and soundlessly. Gu Lingzhao gradually could no longer see the path ahead. After stepping through the main gates, she waved her hand to dismiss the servants of the Prince's Estate. When she finally crossed into her own bedchamber, Gu Lingzhao could no longer sustain her body; stumbling, she collapsed onto the floor.

"My Lady!" Nanqing and Nanyu cried out in unison, scrambling over to help Gu Lingzhao up.

"I'm fine." Gu Lingzhao sat on the floor, turning back to see Nanyu's eyes red with tears. She reached out to wipe away Nanyu's tears, then opened her arms to embrace them both. These two maids who had grown up alongside her were long regarded in her heart as inseparable kin.

Nanyu, who was usually talkative, was sensible enough not to dare say another half-word.

"Don't cry, it's fine, everything will pass," Gu Lingzhao repeated in a low voice, bitterness filling her heart like bitter melon upon the tongue. How she wished this were merely a nightmare; unfortunately, the pain in her chest left her no room to deceive herself.

That night, Gu Lingzhao allowed no one to keep her company. She changed out of her wedding robes, sat on the bed with her knees pulled up in silence, her eyes numb within the darkness. She did not want to cry anymore; she, too, had her own pride and backbone. Tonight, she had run back to the Mingzhao Pavilion with a face full of tears, and she had no idea how many people would use her as a laughing stock after dinner in the days to come.

Gu Lingzhao's head ached as if it were splitting, a chaotic flurry of thoughts flying through her mind, the Xuanping Marquis's Mansion, Ye Jing... Every single matter chilled her to the bone. She wanted to calm down, but the waves of pain surging from her chest prevented her from recovering her past calm and poise.

In her haziness, it was nearly the fifth watch. A faint sliver of light filtered in through the window, and endless exhaustion made Gu Lingzhao feel her body growing heavier and heavier. In a daze, she actually dreamed of the scene when she first met Ye Jing.

Back then, Gu Lingzhao had been framed by others, drawing a flood of rumors and gossip. During that period, she seemed plagued by bad luck, one vexing affair following another. At that time, Gu Lingzhao was merely twelve years old, encountering the perils of the world for the first time. She stayed cooped up in the estate all day, unwilling to meet strangers, and even avoided crowded places of incense when going to pray at temples.

Precisely because she wanted so much to keep a low profile, she had brought along only two footmen and one maidservant when she went to burn incense. Furthermore, the Wushan Temple was rather remote, so when ill fortune struck and they encountered mountain bandits, her entire group was utterly devoid of any means to fight back. Their carriage was destroyed; Nanqing pulled Gu Lingzhao and ran for her life. Seeing that they truly could not outrun the bandits, Nanqing tried to draw the bandits away alone. Even so, Gu Lingzhao was still surrounded by a group of men. In the desolate wilderness, with a sprained ankle, she collapsed onto the ground, surrounded by vicious fiends wearing leering smiles. In that instant, her eyes were filled with nothing but despair, her mind a vast blank.

With a "swish," a wind-whipped feathered arrow struck squarely in the heart of the bandit leader. That youth clad in dark martial attire descended from the heavens like a divine being, holding a long bow in his left hand, his right hand drawing a slender, sharp cyan blade that drew blood the moment it left its scabbard. Weapons clashed, silver light flashed, and the band of bandits fell one after another before her eyes, completely helpless to fight back.

"Scared out of your wits? Whose young bride are you?"

Gu Lingzhao snapped back to her senses, her eyes widening as she stared at the person squatting before her. The man had an exceptionally bright pair of phoenix eyes, handsome facial features, black hair tied high in a silver crown, and even when holding back his aura as he raised an eyebrow to question her, he still could not conceal the untamed arrogance between his brows.

"I am the daughter of the Marquis of Xuanping! I am grateful for your life-saving grace, Young Master, but my maidservant is likely still in grave danger. I beg you to extend a helping hand, and the Marquis's Mansion will certainly send a thousand pieces of gold in gratitude later!"

"The daughter of the Gu family?" A flicker of emotion crossed Ye Jing's expression as he pressed his lips together and scrutinized Gu Lingzhao carefully.

"Young Master, my maidservant..."

"Oh, you needn't worry. It was precisely your maidservant who pointed me in your direction; she has already been rescued. How are you? Can you still walk?"

Gu Lingzhao looked in a daze at the hand extended toward her, a trace of hesitation flashing in her heart, but the next moment she placed her hand into his palm. The contrast between her hand, chilled and yet to warm up, and the warmth of the youth's palm was too stark, feeling as though she had grabbed a small brazier.

After borrowing his strength to stand up, Gu Lingzhao immediately withdrew her hand. "This humble maiden is deeply grateful for the Young Master's great kindness, but I have yet to ask your esteemed name, nor where you reside."

"My name is Ye Jing."

"Ye Jing!" Gu Lingzhao snapped awake with a start, lunging out to grasp at empty air, but not even that trace of warmth from the dream remained in her palm. In the end, she could not hold back; she covered her face and sobbed aloud. She didn't know what she had done wrong to end up in such a plight. Clearly, just the day before, she had been yearning for her grand wedding, longing for the long life ahead of her and Ye Jing.

chapters.title: Are You Still Going to Lie to Me?
chapters.content:
Turning to look out the window, the sky was now completely bright.

Gu Lingzhao rubbed her eyes, wiped her face, and called Nanqing and Nanyu in with a hoarse voice.

"Nanqing, try today to see if you can make contact with someone from the Marquis's Mansion. Just find out the situation in the estate; do not let yesterday's events spread."

"Nanyu, you don't need to stay with me. Walk around outside the courtyard more often. If anyone speaks to you or hands you something, come back and report to me immediately." Thinking of the slip of paper in her hand from yesterday, Gu Lingzhao reasoned that if someone was lurking in the shadows, this surely wouldn't be their only move. For now, she could only wait quietly for developments before making further plans.

Nanyu furrowed her brow and asked, "My Lady, if both my sister and I leave, what will become of you?"

"It's fine. The Prince's Estate is not lacking in attendants; having others around is the same. For now, he hasn't reached the point of wanting my life." Though later on, that might not be the case.

According to convention, the first day after the wedding required going to the imperial palace to offer tea. However, due to the sudden upheaval in the Gu family and the Emperor's fury, coupled with the fact that Ye Jing was already out of favor with the Emperor, no one dared to bring the matter up before the Emperor. Everyone tacitly ignored it, which incidentally spared Gu Lingzhao from a round of ordeal. She stayed in her room until the sun was high overhead; aside from servants delivering meals, no one else came to seek her out or give her tasks.

Gu Lingzhao sat there quietly all alone. The entire Mingzhao Pavilion was frighteningly silent. By now, she had long since lacked the leisure to care about these wedding rites; she and Ye Jing hadn't even drunk the nuptial wine, and whether the ceremony was completed or not was something she no longer cared about.

A flurry of hurried footsteps sounded outside the door, and Nanyu strode quickly into the room, her gaze anxious as she looked at Gu Lingzhao.

"All of you, out." Gu Lingzhao waved her hand to dismiss the other maidservants. At this moment, the servants within the Mingzhao Pavilion still obeyed her commands.

When only the mistress and servant remained in the room, Nanyu walked up to Gu Lingzhao and reported in a low voice, "Less than fifty paces outside the gates of the Mingzhao Pavilion, by the rockery on the west side; an unfamiliar little maid suddenly shoved this letter into my hand, and before I could question her, she vanished."

Gu Lingzhao took the envelope handed over by Nanyu. Unlike yesterday's scrap of paper, today's delivery was a very formal letter. The paper material of the envelope was of supreme quality, and the wax seal bore neat, elegant calligraphy reading: "To be personally opened by Gu Lingzhao."

"Go lock the door."

"Yes." Nanyu moved quickly. After carefully locking the door to the room, she turned back to see that Gu Lingzhao had already torn open the envelope. She walked to Gu Lingzhao's side and voiced her confusion, "My Lady, the person who came and went like a ghost; we don't know if they are friend or foe."

Gu Lingzhao did not answer Nanyu in words, but her trembling hands told the whole story. That thin sheet of letter paper held between Gu Lingzhao's slender fingers felt as heavy as a mountain, directly bowing her straight spine. Gu Lingzhao had been clever since childhood, possessing a photographic memory; for a letter like this, half a cup of tea's time was enough to read it through twice.

Yet at this moment, she seemed unable to make sense of the black-and-white text. She repeatedly deciphered it character by character, her face already as pale as wax, her pair of beautiful, bright eyes bloodshot, completely unaware that she had bitten through the corner of her lip.

"My Lady, My Lady, what is wrong?" Nanyu asked in a frightened tone as she steadied Gu Lingzhao's shoulders. She swore she had never seen her usually gentle and kind mistress wear such a terrifying expression.

"Is the situation at the Marquis's Mansion bad?"

"...There is no mention of the Marquis's Mansion here. It speaks of some old matters. Take it and burn it."

Nanyu nodded hastily, took the letter, and turned to find her flint. Just as she ignited a corner of the letter paper, a loud "bang" rang out as the door was suddenly kicked open. Startled, Nanyu dropped the burning paper, letting it float down onto the floor.

"In broad daylight, why lock the door?" Ye Jing stepped into the room, spotting the abnormality at once. His hawk-like eyes fixed on Nanyu. "What are you two doing?"

Nanyu was so terrified by Ye Jing's overwhelming aura that she dared not move, her entire body seemingly pinned in place. Back in the peaceful days, Ye Jing would stick to Gu Lingzhao day in and day out. At that time, Ye Jing seemed to have no temper; even when teased by Nanyu, he would only flash a silly smile at Gu Lingzhao, looking completely unconcerned. But at this moment, Nanyu had no doubt that Ye Jing could kill her as effortlessly as flicking dust.

"Why has Your Highness come here?" Gu Lingzhao remained seated in her original spot, looking up at Ye Jing's face, her voice exceptionally calm. "Nanyu, put out the fire."

Ye Jing snapped out of his gaze to size up Gu Lingzhao. He felt that her face was several shades paler, and her entire person looked a circle thinner. He wasn't surprised by Gu Lingzhao's complexion; knowing these matters, it would truly be a miracle if she were in a good mood.

"This is the Prince's Estate; I do not need anyone else's permission to step inside. Zhaozhao, times are unstable lately; it would be best if you and your maidservants do not act on your own accord. Aside from this estate, there is no safer place anywhere else." With a wave of Ye Jing's hand, Nanqing was pushed in with her hands bound.

Gu Lingzhao's expression startled; she stood up abruptly and checked Nanqing over for injuries, only then letting out a slight breath of relief. When she glanced sideways at Ye Jing, however, the fury and hatred in her eyes could no longer be concealed, the resentment within them even heavier than yesterday's.

"You haven't answered me; what were you just burning?" Ye Jing watched Gu Lingzhao's expression, feeling an inexplicable stifling in his chest. He abruptly turned his face away, unwilling to meet her eyes, and turned his gaze back to Nanyu instead.

"Your Highness, I have some matters I wish to discuss with you alone. Let them step outside first," Gu Lingzhao said, her voice laden with exhaustion. Governed by a habit formed over years, when facing numerous matters simultaneously, Ye Jing would invariably listen to Gu Lingzhao's voice first. Although the cultivation of this habit was tangled with interests and not purely born of sincerity, for the moment, it was impossible to correct.

"All of you, out."

The moment everyone withdrew and the door closed, Ye Jing acutely sensed that the person before him had shifted into an entirely different aura.

Gu Lingzhao stared straight at Ye Jing and cut straight to the point. "In the eighteenth year of Zhenghwu, Du Yufu framed me for pushing her into the water. All the servants present at the time were bribed by her; they joined forces to turn black into white and invert right from wrong, leaving me with no way to clear my name. Afterward, rumors ran wild in the capital, claiming I bullied others and acted tyrannically and arrogantly, instantly turning me into a notorious pariah reviled by all."

"Why bring this up now?" Ye Jing looked fixedly at Gu Lingzhao, his eyes deep and bottomless like a cold pool.

Not a trace of fear showed in Gu Lingzhao's gaze as she enunciated clearly and calmly, "Back then, the rumors surged too fiercely, splashing dirty water all the way from the Gu Estate onto the Third Prince. With no other choice, the Gu family had to break off the marriage with him."

"What are you trying to remind me of by saying this now?" An unnamable fury suddenly ignited in Ye Jing's ink-black pupils.

"What is Your Highness angry about?" The corners of Gu Lingzhao's lips hooked up into a helpless, light smile. "Your Highness should know the harm that incident did to me. Speaking of which, my encounter with Your Highness also took place after that."

"Ye Tang is already married now. Even if you harbor regrets, it is of no use. No matter how powerful the Gu family's influence is, you cannot possibly marry two princes." Ye Jing spat out the cold words like bamboo spears lined with barbs, piercing straight into Gu Lingzhao's heart, drawing blood with every inch. She had always known this person possessed a fierce personality, and when malicious, his tongue could be as sharp as a blade; but back then, she was merely watching the fire from across the shore and could not feel the pain.

Gu Lingzhao forcefully held back the choked sob in her throat, continuing the train of thought that had almost been disrupted. "I merely wish to ask Your Highness, did you really see me for the very first time at the foot of Mount Wushan?"

A flash of guilt crossed Ye Jing's eyes, and his tone softened quite a bit. "Why ask this?"

"Are you still going to lie to me?" Gu Lingzhao closed her eyes and took a deep breath, large tears slipping silently from the corners of her eyes. "Ye Jing, back then at the Jiang Estate, when Du Yufu jumped into the water herself, were you right there on the spot?!"

chapters.title: The Mastermind is by Your Side
chapters.content:
Ye Jing suddenly froze, his expression looking even more guilty than it had when the two of them confronted each other last night.

"Not only were you there at the time, seeing the entire process of me being framed with your own eyes, but afterward, when the capital was flooded with rumors, you also played a part in it, didn't you?"

Gu Lingzhao stared fixedly at Ye Jing, her dark brown eyes filled with sorrow and pain.

For some inexplicable reason, Ye Jing feared her gaze and did not dare meet her eyes.

"...... Throughout the entire capital, the people who genuinely wanted to see you and Ye Tang enter into a political marriage could be counted on one hand."

With a sharp "crack," a slap finally landed on Ye Jing's face.

"Then did you know that I was already barely surviving at that time? I lived in fear and trembling day after day, unable to sleep in peace... How could you have the nerve to come and comfort me with such an innocent face!"

"Do you even have a heart!" Gu Lingzhao's voice was hoarse beyond measure, as if all her strength had been drained from her, and she finally collapsed weakly to her knees. The pain she had forcefully suppressed last night returned today with the might of ten thousand jun, doubling down to completely crush Gu Lingzhao's sincere heart. She helplessly covered her face, hurting so much that she couldn't even keep her sobs coherent.

Ye Jing lowered his gaze, silently looking at Gu Lingzhao. He was not surprised by this slap; he even felt that she should have struck him yesterday. Gu Lingzhao had been physically frail since childhood, and the slap delivered in a fit of rage did not even leave a burning sensation on Ye Jing's face.

Everything before him was something he had anticipated many years ago, but for some reason, Ye Jing felt extremely distressed, as if thorny vines were growing from the soles of his feet, crawling all over his body from bottom to top. Every time Gu Lingzhao sobbed, these thorny vines would prick him. The pain did not reach deep, but the painful spots were so dense that he could not locate the root cause.

He eventually attributed these unexpected emotions to shame. After all, he was a living human being; having used schemes and plots to trick a young lady into so much suffering, it was only natural to feel some guilt in his heart.

Ye Jing came up with one reason after another in his mind, thus successfully persuading himself without any obstruction.

"For this period of time, you will have to suffer the grievance of staying only within the estate. Regardless of the original purpose, you are now my wife, and I certainly will not treat you unfairly."

Ye Jing wanted to say that if she was willing, the two of them could still return to the past, and he could still treat her well just like before... But the words died on his lips, and even he felt how feeble they sounded.

So be it. Gu Lingzhao was not someone who would stubbornly dwell in a dead end. Given a little more time, she would definitely figure out what the most advantageous choice for her was.

"Ye Jing, I'll only ask you this once: does this matter have anything to do with you and the First Prince?"

Ye Jing answered readily this time: "No."

Afraid that Gu Lingzhao wouldn't believe him, he went on to explain: "This time, the Fourth Brother and Prime Minister Du made a sudden move, and Eldest Brother was also caught off guard."

"Zhaozhao." Ye Jing squatted down, keeping his line of sight level with Gu Lingzhao's, though she was unwilling to look at him. "You can be angry and vent your temper on me however you like. But I'll make this clear first: do not try by every means possible to contact people outside. I may not be able to do anything to you, but as for your maidservants, if there is a next time, I will absolutely not spare them. The Xuanping Marquisate can't look after you right now, and there are countless villains waiting for you to walk into their trap."

"Then when... when can I regain my freedom?" Crystal tears still hung on Gu Lingzhao's eyelashes. By now, she no longer had the strength to cry bitterly, and only stared blankly at the floor.

"Once this matter settles down and the Xuanping Marquisate survives this crisis, everything can be restored to how it was."

"Can it really go back to how it was?" Gu Lingzhao asked softly to herself, then turned her head and raised her eyes to fixate on Ye Jing: "Deep down in your heart, do you truly hope the Gu family survives this tribulation?"

Ye Jing avoided her gaze and answered, "Naturally. The Gu family is a century-old noble clan with countless loyal ministers, and Marquis Gu is a pillar of the nation. Everyone in the imperial court knows full well that the Xuanping Marquisate was framed and wronged. In fact, you don't need to shed tears for the Gu family every day; Third Brother will not let the Gu family fall into ruin."

"Ye Jing, no, Ninth Highness..." Gu Lingzhao suddenly changed her attitude. She grabbed the hem of Ye Jing's robe, kneeling on both knees on the ground in an extremely humble posture. "Can you beg the Eldest Prince to help my father? If the Gu family falls at a time like this, it will be equally disadvantageous to the Eldest Prince. The Fourth Prince has a perverse and violent temper, stops at nothing to achieve his goals, and yet he enjoys the Emperor's favoritism... When the time truly comes for a life-and-death struggle, the Third Prince will definitely fall behind. As long as the Gu family can safely weather this tribulation, I can cooperate with you. I can pretend that nothing bad ever happened, and in front of others, we can still be a loving couple!"

"You..."

Ye Jing pressed his lips into a tight line. In his heart, he admitted that what Gu Lingzhao said made a lot of sense. Ye Tang had once said that if Gu Lingzhao were a man, she would definitely possess the talent of a military strategist. And she was indeed just as he imagined, quickly able to come up with the most advantageous countermeasure for herself.

However, when these logic points that he had wanted Gu Lingzhao to figure out were actually spoken by her, hearing her casually connect their relationship through interests, Ye Jing felt a nameless, bitter tightness in his chest.

"...Don't kneel to me." Ye Jing took a deep breath, feeling that this place was so oppressive it made him unable to breathe. "I cannot make decisions for my eldest brother."

"I can go persuade the Eldest Prince; you take me to see him. Passing a message will do, or let me see Lu Qin."

"Lu Qin? Are you really that unafraid of death?" Ye Jing almost let out a cold laugh. "The best thing you can do right now is not let anyone remember your existence."

Ye Jing had no desire to tell Gu Lingzhao that outside, regarding the case of the Xuanping Marquisate, while it might not be rivers of blood, the number of people losing their heads over this was by no means small. The Gu family was bound to suffer a vital blow, and yesterday she had run right into Lu Qin. In his eldest brother's eyes, she was already a spent piece. Among Ye Zhang's numerous strategists, Lu Qin happened to be the most ruthless one. He absolutely refused to believe that Lu Qin had no hand in the fact that Gu Lingzhao had been able to listen in on their conversation unimpeded last night.

Hiding in this deep courtyard, it was best for her to maintain a low profile, making herself dispensable so that Ye Zhang would forget about her. No matter what the outcome for the Gu family was, he would still be able to protect her so she could live out her days in peace and comfort with adequate food and clothing.

"Zhaozhao, everything I am doing now is for your own good."

"If you truly cared about my life and death, how could you set such a fatal trap to trick me!"

"......So you can resent me all you want, hate me..." Ye Jing stood up and refused to look at Gu Lingzhao's expression any longer. No one could predict this sudden disaster, but he was well aware that everything he was doing now was being watched by others, and the slightest misstep could send Gu Lingzhao to her death.

He would rather Gu Lingzhao resent him; he wouldn't wrong himself over it. Whether Gu Lingzhao loved or hated him, those illusory, ethereal emotions, he had never cared about them.

No matter what things came to in the future, at this very moment, he had to at least protect Gu Lingzhao's life.

"Stay well in Mingzhao Pavilion. I'll have someone send over some tonics. A constitution like yours cannot withstand being tossed about like this. If you starve to death in my place, your eldest brother won't let me off." Seeing Gu Lingzhao lowering her eyes without a word, Ye Jing, regardless of whether she was willing or not, directly pulled her by the arm and carried Gu Lingzhao back to the bed. "Autumn is here, the floor is cold. If you need any daily provisions, just have someone go find the steward; no one will treat you poorly."

chapters.title: Blood-Stained Secret Letter
chapters.content:
Ye Jing did not stay long in Mingzhao Pavilion, nor did he dare stay any longer. He assumed Gu Lingzhao had understood his words; as long as she obediently stayed in Mingzhao Pavilion and behaved submissively, his birth mother in the palace and his eldest brother would spare no energy to deal with her.

Not long after Ye Jing left, a dainty little maid in pink clothes walked up to Gu Lingzhao and said respectfully, "Imperial Prince's Consort, the meal has been laid out. Allow this servant to wait upon you for dinner."

Gu Lingzhao stared straight ahead with vacant eyes and asked in a low, hoarse voice, "What is your name?"

"This servant is called Zhixun."

"Ha," Gu Lingzhao gave a light laugh, "What a good name. Send Nanqing and Nanyu in; I only want them to personally wait on me."

"His Highness gave instructions: only after the Imperial Prince's Consort has finished her meal can the two older sisters, Nanqing and Nanyu, return."

Gu Lingzhao turned her head and glared at her, only to see the little girl looking nervous, sweat even beading on her forehead.

A flash of powerlessness crossed her heart. Forget it, Gu Lingzhao thought to herself, why should I make things difficult for a little maid? This isn't her sin.

"Help me over there."

Hearing Gu Lingzhao relent, joy immediately appeared on Zhixun's face. "Yes!"

Facing the table full of dishes, Gu Lingzhao not only had zero appetite, but even felt a faint wave of nausea. Yet she still picked up chopsticks, forcefully shoving bite after bite into her mouth. On the one hand, she wanted to get Nanqing and Nanyu back; on the other hand, she did not want to collapse at a time like this. Therefore, even though she choked until tears welled up in her eyes, she forced herself to eat her fill.

For three consecutive days, Ye Jing did not set foot in Mingzhao Pavilion, but those secret letters of unknown origin were delivered into Gu Lingzhao's hands one after another. This was also the result of her deliberate concealment. If this piece of paper were to appear in the sight of anyone else in Mingzhao Pavilion, Ye Jing would likely appear here in less than half a day.

Gu Lingzhao could not guess what Ye Jing was thinking, nor did she have the mental energy to guess. However, the contents of those secret letters were terrifying to read. Black ink on white paper, yet they laid bare bleeding wounds. In just a few short days, her father's former retainers and students, those familiar names, had now become souls under the sword. Gu Lingzhao felt that this thin paper in her hand was like a stack of death warrants, with every single character carrying the intent to claim lives.

Whenever Gu Lingzhao closed her eyes, she would see one bloody head after another appearing before her. She didn't want to look, yet in her dreams she couldn't shut her eyes no matter what. She was forced to clearly see the faces of these people, and she prayed in terror not to see her family members here. However, as the long night dragged on, endless blood eventually dyed the entire dreamscape crimson.

"Miss, Miss." Nanqing and Nanyu's anxious voices sounded beside her ear. Gu Lingzhao started awake abruptly, her body already covered in a cold sweat.

"What time is it?"

"It's already the Si hour (9 AM - 11 AM). Miss just had a nightmare, and no matter how Nanyu and I called you, we couldn't wake you."

"Si hour? How could I have slept for so long!"

"Miss, you didn't fall asleep until the Third Watch, and your sleep was restless. It's normal to sleep in a bit. As for those letters of unknown origin, perhaps we shouldn't read them anymore in the future. We can't tell if they're true or false, and they only cause Miss needless distress."

"The distress lies in the matter itself, it has nothing to do with the letters."

Nanyu choked back a sob: "Miss, please take good care of your health. My Lord and the Young Master are blessed people; nothing will happen to them. I'm scared when I see you like this."

"Don't talk nonsense!" Nanqing interrupted Nanyu.

"Wash me up and change my clothes. Today is a rest day, and the Eldest Prince will very likely come over to discuss things with Ye Jing. I'm going to intercept him."

"This..." Nanqing hesitated. "Does Miss have a way to persuade the Eldest Prince? If the Ninth Highness finds out, he'll probably lose his temper again."

"On the stage of life and death, an extra ounce of strength, no matter how meager, has the chance to turn the tide around. Ye Jing has spent little time in the capital; he has no idea the extent to which the Emperor favored Ye Xuan in the early years. Besides, the ones whose life or death is unknown right now are not his father and brother; how could he possibly understand the feeling of being on tenterhooks?"

"Trapped here as I am, I've reached a dead end. Since it's death either way, why not fight for it one last time? Nanyu, go find me a change of light, easy-to-move-in clothes. We can't get out through the front gate; in a moment, Nanqing will go lure the people in the back courtyard away, and we can climb over the back wall. We'll land right in the garden area, which will conceal our movements well."

Hearing this, Nanyu looked out through the window, licked her lips, and said, "That wall in the back courtyard is quite high, Miss. Why don't I jump out first and catch you?"

"No need, you guys go prepare."

In truth, Nanyu's worry was not without reason. Stepping on objects to climb up to the top of the wall was still somewhat easy for Gu Lingzhao, but then she gritted her teeth and jumped downward abruptly. As soon as she landed, a sharp pain shot through her right ankle.

Indeed, her physical weakness could not keep up with her ambitions. Gu Lingzhao had been raised delicately as the darling daughter of Marquis Gu in her boudoir. She had practiced horseback riding for two or three years, but in the end she had only learned how to ride; getting on and off the horse required someone to support her with utmost care, terrified that this delicate beauty might suffer even the slightest bump. Of course, all along, the role of hovering around Gu Lingzhao and attending to her every need had been played by Ye Jing.

Choosing secluded paths, Gu Lingzhao endured the pain as she walked while cursing Ye Jing as despicable in her heart. Under the guise of currying favor and showing consideration all these years, he must have harbored the intention of raising her into a useless person from the very beginning.

Although Ye Jing's estate occupied a considerable area, the architecture inside was far less rigidly exquisite and refined than that of the century-old noble clans in the capital. Ye Jing had grown up in Mount Cangsu and was never tainted by the extravagant and decadent hobbies of aristocratic youths. As for his food and daily use, "getting by" had always been good enough for him. The sophisticated furnishings and precious trees in this estate had almost all been arranged according to Gu Lingzhao's opinions.

However, times had changed; the present Gu Lingzhao had no desire to take a close look at a single blade of grass or tree in this estate. The more beautiful and sweet those memories were, the more foolish and ridiculous she appeared.

Gu Lingzhao followed the small path, using several large trees for cover. Along the way, she reached the front hall without running into a single person. Hiding behind a dense cluster of tree branches, she immediately spotted Ye Zhang's silvery-white robes. Lu Qin was standing off to the side, while Mushui was bowing respectfully, seemingly in the middle of sending off a guest.

Com pounded by several days of anxiety and haunted by nightmares, Gu Lingzhao's mind was not very sharp at the moment. She lifted her foot, intending to shout out and stop Ye Zhang, but the next moment, an arm suddenly materialized out of thin air across her front. Before she could react, her waist suddenly tightened, and her back slammed against what felt like a hard wall of rock.

A chill instantly surged from the soles of her feet to her whole body. She wanted to shout, but discovered she couldn't make a sound at all.

One of Ye Jing's arms wrapped around Gu Lingzhao's waist, while his other hand covered her mouth, pressing Gu Lingzhao fiercely into his embrace.

Gu Lingzhao's left hand was unrestricted, but no matter how she pinched or scratched, she could not budge Ye Jing in the slightest. She could only watch helplessly as Ye Zhang's back gradually faded from view, as if watching hope vanish piece by piece right before her eyes.

chapters.title: Her Last Words to Him
chapters.content:
Just as Ye Jing's grip loosened slightly, Gu Lingzhao leaned forward and bit directly into the web of his thumb. Having completely lost her reason, her fear and anger mixed with grievance rushed to her brain, obliterating even that shred of terror she had felt toward Ye Jing.

Only when the sweet, metallic taste of blood filled her entire mouth did Gu Lingzhao's senses return. Her bite had been deep and vicious; even after she released her grip, blood continued to seep from the tooth marks.

Before she could process what was happening, the world spun, and she found herself hoisted directly over Ye Jing's shoulder.

"Let me go! How dare you treat me like this! Put me down! Ye Jing, you jerk! Bastard!"

Gu Lingzhao's vocabulary for scolding was pitifully meager; throughout her upbringing, she had almost never uttered such crude language to anyone.

Ignoring her struggles entirely, Ye Jing carried her silently back to the Mingzhao Pavilion. He intended to toss Gu Lingzhao back onto the bed, but because of her sudden thrashing, she slipped from his grasp and slid straight down onto the floor. Burning with anger, Ye Jing made no move to help her up.

Little did he know, this fall caused Gu Lingzhao's lower back to slam hard against the edge of the bed. A sharp, agonizing pain turned her face instantly pale, leaving her hunched over and speechless. Through her peripheral vision, she could only catch the sway of Ye Jing's robes as he strode away. He walked so fast, as if even sparing a single extra word to her was a chore.

Gu Lingzhao clenched her teeth, raising her head to stare fixedly at Ye Jing's receding back. That tall, dark-robed figure did not pause for even a second. As he stepped out the main door, she instinctively raised a hand to call out to him, but heart palpitations robbed her of her voice. In that brief hesitation, Ye Jing walked out of the room.

Ultimately, Gu Lingzhao's words remained unspoken. Staring blankly in the direction he had left, she felt a lingering chill wrapped around her heart. It didn't hurt, it simply felt as though a gaping hole had been torn open, with blood welling out continuously, alternating between warm and cold, leaving her entirely numb.

After a long while, the pain in her lower back subsided somewhat, but the moment she tried to move, that stabbing ache struck again, making it impossible for her to pull herself up.

"Nanqing, Nanyu..." Gu Lingzhao called out twice, but there was no response. The entire Mingzhao Pavilion was dead silent; the only sound Gu Lingzhao could hear was the faint, persistent ringing in her ears.

If heartbreak is said to happen in an instant, then on her wedding day, faced with all those truths, Gu Lingzhao had still been able to rely on her pride to keep her spine straight and fake a calm, composed demeanor. Yet the bone-deep, marrow-gnawing agony would not be lessened by a single bit just because of her endurance at the time. Those once-fond memories, contrasted against her current plight, combined to form the sharpest blade, repeatedly stabbing into her heart over and over again.

She didn't know how much time had passed before the surrounding environment gradually grew dark. Yet another agonizing, sleepless night approached. Suddenly, Gu Lingzhao desperately wanted to go home. She didn't want to stay in this place for even a single second longer; she missed her father, she missed her eldest brother. In this world, countless villains existed, but only her family would never harm her.

Under the crushing blow, Gu Lingzhao's mental state was far worse than she let on. As darkness consumed her surroundings, she plunged completely into a state of chaos, unable to distinguish reality from dreams. Bizarre and kaleidoscopic visions flashed before her eyes. She saw the Ye Jing of her memories running toward her with heartache and urgency, only for him to morph instantly into someone sitting in the distance, a pair of dark, lifeless eyes devoid of any emotion. She saw her eldest brother appear before her with a smile, but then a silver flash crossed her vision, turning everything a dark, bloody crimson...

When she opened her eyes again, dawn had broken. Seeing her wake up, Zhixun immediately stepped forward to greet her. "How is the Imperial Princess feeling? You fell asleep leaning against the bedside yesterday, and Mama Li carried you to the bed. If you are feeling unwell, this maid will send for a doctor immediately."

Lying flat on her back, Gu Lingzhao felt as though every inch of her body ached. She coughed twice and asked weakly, "I'm fine. Where are Nanqing and Nanyu?"

Zhixun's expression turned somewhat unnatural. Tucking the blanket around Gu Lingzhao, she said, "The Imperial Princess should still put her health first. In this world, nothing is more..."

"I asked you where Nanqing and Nanyu are!"

Gu Lingzhao propped herself up and sat up. This was the first time she had ever lost her temper at a servant in this estate.

"May the Imperial Princess forgive me." Zhixun immediately knelt, saying nervously, "Sisters Nanqing and Nanyu were punished by His Highness with ten strikes of the paddle for dereliction of duty, and are temporarily unable to serve the Imperial Princess."

"They are my personal maids! By what right does Ye Jing touch them? I'm going to find him. He's gone too far! By what right?!"

Paying no heed to her dizziness, Gu Lingzhao threw off the blanket, wanting to go find Ye Jing to demand an explanation, only to be blocked by Zhixun once again.

"Imperial Princess, His Highness has given orders that you are not to leave the Mingzhao Pavilion for the time being."

Caught and held back by Zhixun, Gu Lingzhao was so angry she nearly lost her breath. "...Then I'll go check on Nanqing and Nanyu. Surely that's allowed?"

"Th-that is also forbidden by His Highness." Zhixun stepped forward to support Gu Lingzhao, gently persuading her, "His Highness didn't punish them too harshly; sisters Nanqing and Nanyu will be able to return in two days. Why doesn't the Imperial Princess focus on recuperating first? Once you have recovered your health, His Highness will naturally lift your confinement. His Highness holds you in his heart; it's simply that he's in a bad mood right now. Why bother going to provoke him?"

Gu Lingzhao closed her eyes. She had truly experienced the feeling of having her hands tied and wishing she were dead. In the past, whenever she heard rumors of certain madams or young misses being driven to madness, she would feel curious and uncomprehending; how could a perfectly normal person be driven insane? Ultimately, it was because she had been too naive, and the Marquis's estate had protected her far too well. Du Yufu's frame-up back then had eventually been returned in full measure by her eldest brother. She didn't know what methods were used, but in the end, no one in the entire capital ever dared to make trouble in front of her again.

"When did you come to this estate?"

" Replying to the Imperial Princess, this maid was sent to the estate by Noble Consort De a year ago."

Gu Lingzhao opened her dim eyes, turned her head, and carefully scrutinized Zhixun. "So you were stationed in the palace before this?"

"This maid only stayed in the palace for half a year, and spent most of that time learning etiquette. Since I was sent to serve the Imperial Princess, the Imperial Princess is this maid's master. Zhixun would never dare harbor a divided heart in serving her master."

Watching Zhixun pledge her loyalty with fear and trembling, Gu Lingzhao felt only self-mockery. Being loyal to the Imperial Princess did not necessarily mean being loyal to her; who knew how many future Imperial Princesses would require this loyalty?

"Go to my dressing case and take some silver to tip the kitchens, and have them send some food suitable for recovery to Nanqing and Nanyu."

"Understood, this maid obeys."

"Also, later on, bring the person who delivers meals from the kitchen to me. I have instructions to give them personally."

"Yes." Suspecting nothing, Zhixun merely thought to herself with admiration that the Imperial Princess was indeed as kind-hearted as the rumors said.

chapters.title: The Handwriting of Marquis Gu
chapters.content:
The person sent from the kitchen was a young maid, not very old, wearing her hair in a pair of double buns. She stood respectfully inside the bedchamber.

Because Gu Lingzhao had been resting in bed and disliked having a crowd surrounding her, she had kept only Zhixun by her side to serve.

"Imperial Princess, this is little Lin from the kitchen. If you have any instructions, just tell her."

"Greetings, the Imperial Princess." Little Lin cast a quick glance at Gu Lingzhao before promptly lowering her gaze.

"Zhixun, I keep hearing birds calling outside. It's giving me a headache. Go have someone chase them away."

Half-reclining against the bed, Gu Lingzhao pressed a hand to her forehead in pain. Her pale complexion left Zhixun with no reason to doubt her.

The moment Zhixun stepped out, Little Lin walked straight forward. All trace of respect vanished from her demeanor, and the look she directed at Gu Lingzhao seemed laced with provocation.

"Imperial Princess, this is the kitchen's menu roster. Please take a look."

Gu Lingzhao took the slip of paper, unfolded it, and took a single look before her face drained of color.

It was her father's handwriting, instructing her to return to the estate by tomorrow night without fail to see him.

"Where did this come from? Whose person are you, really?"

Little Lin smiled faintly. "My identity doesn't matter. What matters is that this note was written in Marquis Gu's own hand. If the Imperial Princess is unwilling to take the risk, this maid will simply pretend she was never here."

"Impudent! Aren't you afraid I'll have someone deal with you right now?!"

"May the Imperial Princess forgive me. If you had no intention of meeting, this maid naturally wouldn't have had the opportunity to come here."

Gu Lingzhao suddenly thought of that other note, the one exposing Ye Jing and the Du family for conspiring to ruin her reputation.

Glaring at Little Lin, she said coldly, "Are you Du Yufu's person?"

"The Imperial Princess is truly a clever person. Indeed, our mistress has some friendship with the Ninth Highness, which is why this maid is able to appear here safely." Unafraid and unfazed, Little Lin maintained a respectful posture, though her eyes told a completely different story.

Gu Lingzhao gripped the edge of the blanket tightly, her face almost as pale as paper. She didn't dare to dwell on the relationship between Ye Jing and Du Yufu. The Gu family and the Du family supported the Fifth Prince and the Seventh Prince respectively, locked in a life-or-death struggle, and Du Yufu bore an inexplicable, bone-deep hatred for her.

Whatever the relationship between Ye Jing and Du Yufu might be, it was enough to make Gu Lingzhao feel as nauseated as if she had swallowed a fly.

Seeing Gu Lingzhao in a daze, Little Lin followed Du Yufu's instructions to pour oil on the fire. "The Imperial Princess is the mistress; how to deal with this maid is entirely your prerogative. But without this maid, you will only ever learn about the situation of the Marquis of Xuanping's estate from the Ninth Highness's lips. The Imperial Princess probably doesn't know yet, but your second uncle, General Gu Sheng, has already been brought to justice for the crimes of treason and delaying military strategy. Your two male cousins, likely out of shame, have already committed suicide in their prison cells. No doubt the Ninth Highness failed to mention these matters to you."

Crack. Gu Lingzhao's fingernail snapped cleanly into the bedding. The streak of blood against the bright red silk was hardly noticeable, and she felt no pain at all.

"This maid can swear to the heavens that every word spoken is true. If you do not believe it, you are free to seek verification from the Ninth Highness."

"...What on earth do you people want?"

"Since we are old acquaintances, our mistress is willing to help the Ninth Imperial Princess keep this appointment."

Hearing this, Gu Lingzhao found it utterly laughable. The Gu and Du families had always been at loggerheads, and she and Du Yufu had harbored a grudge since childhood; Du Yufu was clearly setting her up for death!

Yet, the handwriting on that slip of paper made it impossible for her to simply ignore it.

Movement at the doorway signaled Zhixun's return.

"The Imperial Princess should consider this carefully. Perhaps this is your last and only chance to see Marquis Gu again."

With that, Little Lin immediately reverted to her harmless appearance, standing quietly in place.

"If the Imperial Princess has no further instructions, this maid will take her leave. If there are any dishes you wish to eat, Imperial Princess, just have sister Zhixun tell us."

"...Zhixun, go see her out."

"Yes."

As soon as they left, Gu Lingzhao began to cough violently. Pulling away the handkerchief from her mouth, she saw the startling crimson blood staining the snow-white silk.

Nanqing and Nanyu possessed some martial arts training and a solid physical foundation, allowing them to support themselves on their injuries and come see Gu Lingzhao by that afternoon.

To their dismay, the moment they stepped through the door, the dark circles under Gu Lingzhao's eyes and the hollow look within them startled the two maids deeply.

Nanqing knelt beside the bed, anxiously taking Gu Lingzhao's hand. "Milady, what has happened to you? Why have you grown so haggard?"

Zhixun kindly reminded Nanqing from the side, "Sister Nanqing, now that we are in the Imperial Prince's estate, we should address our master as the Imperial Princess."

Indignant, Nanyu opened her mouth to retort, but a single glance from Gu Lingzhao stopped her.

"Zhixun is right. Wherever one is, one must follow the rules of that place. Zhixun..."

"This maid is here."

A flash of hesitation crossed Gu Lingzhao's eyes before she spoke, "Go invite the Ninth Highness here. Tell him I have matters to discuss with him."

Zhixun obediently replied, "Yes, this maid will go invite him right away."

Watching Zhixun leave, Nanyu looked at Gu Lingzhao's chin-sized, shrunken face and suddenly burst into tears, sobbing, "Milady has suffered so much. In just a few days, you've lost so much weight."

A bitter smile touched Gu Lingzhao's face as she gently stroked Nanqing's cheek, murmuring, "You two are the ones who suffered. It's all my fault for dragging you both into this."

Meanwhile, Zhixun had just reached the main gate of the Mingzhao Pavilion. Before she even crossed the threshold, she caught sight of Ye Jing's tall figure standing outside.

An ancient poplar grew outside the Mingzhao Pavilion. In the biting autumn air, even on clear, windless days, withered leaves rained down endlessly, making the place look exceptionally desolate and cold.

"This maid greets His Highness." Zhixun stepped forward to salute.

"Why are you out here? Who is serving inside?"

"Replying to His Highness, the Imperial Princess gave instructions that she has urgent matters and wishes to request an audience with Your Highness."

"She wants to see me?" Ye Jing frowned deeply, asking with a cold expression, "Has someone been saying something to her recently?"

"The Imperial Princess did not specify the reason, only that she wishes to see Your Highness."

Ye Jing nodded and asked, "How is the Imperial Princess? How is her appetite? Has her complexion improved at all?"

"The Imperial Princess's appetite has been mediocre these past few days, and she suffers from frequent nightmares. This maid noticed she has lost even more weight. Will Your Highness accompany this maid inside? The Imperial Princess is waiting for you."

With a dark gaze, Ye Jing thought of the news he had just received, truly unsure of how to face Gu Lingzhao.

He could not help her now, nor did he dare to look upon her tears, so it was better not to meet at all...

Lifting a hand to brush a fallen leaf from his shoulder, Ye Jing spoke with thin, cold indifference, "Do not tell her you saw me here. Tell her I have urgent matters to attend to and no time to come, and instruct her to recuperate properly and take care of her health."

Zhixun's face turned pale, and she wanted to speak further, but intimidated by Ye Jing's oppressive aura, she could only bow and say, "Understood, this maid takes her leave."

Watching Zhixun return to the Mingzhao Pavilion, Ye Jing wanted to leave as well, yet his feet felt rooted to the spot. His heart beat erratically, as if some voice in the dark was telling him not to leave!

Yet he could find no reason to stay. He certainly couldn't possibly have fallen in love with Gu Lingzhao...

After watching the withered leaves fall a few more times, Ye Jing ultimately chose to leave in silence. At that moment, he had no way of knowing that this momentary retreat would brew a consequence he would regret for the rest of his life.

---

"Imperial Princess, His Highness says he has urgent matters to deal with and is temporarily unable to come."

"Did he truly have matters to attend to, or did he simply not want to see me?"

Frightened by the hollowness in Gu Lingzhao's eyes, Zhixun trembled inwardly and hastily replied, "The Imperial Princess overthinks. How could His Highness be unwilling to see you? He even instructed you to take good care of your health."

Gu Lingzhao suddenly laughed. She found herself ridiculously foolish; clearly, they had already broken all pretense, yet she had still lowered her pride to seek help from Ye Jing. Why was she so afraid of death?

The shame and anger erupting within her heart overcame her initial terror, and a sense of liberation unexpectedly rose from the depths of her despair.

Gu Lingzhao made her decision in a single instant.

chapters.title: Flight
chapters.content:
"Please thank His Highness for his concern on my behalf. By the way, could I trouble you to make another trip and tell Xiao Lin in the kitchen that I was very pleased with her morning menu and would like her to prepare more."

"Yes, this servant will go right away." Xunzun didn't think much of it, assuming that Gu Lingzhao was simply trying to dismiss her because she was angry with the Ninth Prince.

"Nanqing, help me up. Nanyu, go fetch that rosewood box from my dressing case."

Gu Lingzhao sat upright on the low couch, holding the rosewood box, and carefully laid out its contents one by one on the tea table.

"Nanqing, Nanyu, these are your deeds of servitude. Take them and destroy them."

As soon as these words were spoken, both Nanqing and Nanyu dropped to their knees in shock.

"My lady, why are you suddenly trying to send us away?!"

"That's right, My lady, don't send us away..."

Gu Lingzhao let out a helpless sigh. "I have driven myself into a desperate situation and do not wish to drag you down with me. Neither of you is a delicate maiden unable to lift a finger; slip away amid tomorrow night's chaos, then go far away and never return."

"My lady, what are you saying?" Nanqing and Nanyu widened their eyes in shock.

Gu Lingzhao sighed silently, then shook her head, saying, "I am a daughter of the Gu family and am bound to share its fate. Rather than living under another's roof and waiting in trembling fear for death, I would rather accompany the Gu family all the way to the netherworld."

Hearing this, Nanyu's eyes turned red with anxiety. "My lady! How can you think such a thing? The Marquis is benevolent and upright; he won't be as you say."

"My lady, this servant knows you've been heartbroken lately, but this is a matter of life and death. You must not make a rash decision out of momentary urgency. Perhaps we can talk to the Ninth Highness again."

"But I no longer wish to see him." A single clear teardrop suddenly fell onto the back of her hand. Gu Lingzhao lowered her gaze for a moment and continued as if nothing were wrong, "His petition to marry me was due to his coveting the Gu family's influence, while simultaneously driving a wedge between my father and the Third Prince. Killing two birds with one stone made it a transaction worth five years of his painstaking pretense. He even went so far as to feign a broken leg and a fractured arm just to win the trust of my father and brothers..."

Gu Lingzhao heaved a deep sigh. "All the humble and abject words I could possibly say, I have said them all. He will not save us... Du Yufu sent word that Father wants me to leave the manor tomorrow to see him."

Nanyu said urgently, "My lady! Du Yufu has been vicious-minded since childhood; how many times has she harmed you both openly and covertly? You must not trust her! This is definitely a conspiracy!"

"Her open scheme is to take my life, but I have no other way out." Gu Lingzhao closed her eyes. "I am afraid that if I miss this chance, I will never see Father again."

"I do not want to let others decide my fate, but neither can I selfishly ruin yours." Seeing that the two refused to accept their deeds of servitude, Gu Lingzhao did not force them, but instead tore the two papers to pieces right then and there.

"...If Ye Jing dares to touch you, it is simply to tell me that he has the final say in this residence." Gu Lingzhao paused, suppressing the tears in her eyes, and mocked herself, "Yet I refuse to grant his wish."

"My lady, no matter what you wish to do, we sisters will surely follow you, even unto death. The Marquis's estate has shown us great grace; how could we be ungrateful and live cowardly lives of ignoble survival?"

"Elder sister is right! We will never part from the lady!"

Nanqing and Nanyu exchanged glances, seeing the determination to die together in each other's eyes. Since their lady did not want to stay here, they would risk their lives to send her out.
