If not for the Phoenix Blood, she would never have stepped foot into that residence for even half a step.

Just as she expected, when facing Ye Jing directly, she could not remain calm as still water.

During her youth, when she was most ignorant of romance, that man forcefully barged into her life, occupying nearly the entirety of her adolescent days. Every memorable event she experienced had Ye Jing's presence woven into it, like a shadow clinging to her.

And from the day Ye Jing's true colors were exposed, her past memories seemed tainted with filth and foulness.

Whenever she remembered Ye Jing's smiles toward her and how well he treated her, she couldn't help but continue thinking: when Ye Jing saw the trust and reliance in her eyes, did he laugh wildly in his heart, mocking her stupidity?

She had been played around like a complete fool!

She utterly loathed that period of time, to the point of despising her own name alongside it.

In the jianghu today, aside from that person, no one knew her real name; even Qingyu only knew the character "Zhao" from her given name.

Regulating her breathing, Gu Lingzhao went to a secret compartment, retrieved a red jade scroll, and sat down at the desk, spreading the scroll open by the candlelight.

The hairpin-style regular script was neat and orderly. Without close inspection, one wouldn't notice the trembling present in the horizontal and vertical strokes. This was her handwriting from four years ago; nowadays, she could no longer write characters this clean.

Stroke by stroke, the names of more than ten people were listed out, though cinnabar brush marks had already been slashed across most of them in an eye-catching manner.

These people were all executioners who had once raised their butcher knives against her family.

Gu Lingzhao held the brush and drew a large "X" over the name Lou Changgui.

With that, this scroll of enemies now had only two names left. Gu Lingzhao pointed her finger at Lou Changfu's name. This person should have been sent to meet King Yama a month ago. It was only because her cultivation had gone awry, nearly causing her to lose all her internal energy, that she had spent nearly a month recuperating before finally recovering.

Taking advantage of this period, this person had packed up his entire family and fled to the capital in a single breath.

Lou Changgui, whom she had intercepted outside the capital earlier, had received word and was preparing to go to the capital to take refuge and hide out with his older brother.

"Lou Changfu," Gu Lingzhao whispered the name softly. "Running fast, huh? Did you think you could survive just by reaching the capital?"

In the Sunan case, her second uncle and two older male cousins had died unjustly in a strange land, and the mastermind at the time was precisely this Lou Changfu.

There were a total of sixteen officials involved in the Sunan case back then. Once she butchered Lou Changfu, she would have completely avenged her second uncle's family.

After that, it would finally be time for her own true family vendetta.

The person who had caused the deaths of her father and eldest brother was currently surrounded by guests of honor, receiving the adulation of all officials.

As her fingertip slid to the name of the very last person, Gu Lingzhao's ears were instantly flooded with countless cries of wailing. Amidst a sky full of blood, her father, up until the very last moment of his death, was still protecting her, telling her to run!

A sudden pain struck her chest, and Gu Lingzhao habitually wiped away the fresh blood spilling from the corner of her lips.

chapters.title: Bloody Past
chapters.content:
Four years ago, she had witnessed with her own eyes Du Hongzhi leading a troop of soldiers wantonly brandishing butcher knives across the Marquis Xuanping's Mansion.

"Lord Gu, do not blame me. Blame yourself for being too overconfident, for daring to touch the apple of our Emperor's eye. What if the Fourth Prince colluded with Dong'an? As long as the Emperor protects him, that piece of evidence you hold is the death warrant for your entire Gu clan!"

"Was it the Emperor who sent you?"

"Your Gu family wields far too much prestige. Without sufficient evidence, the Emperor would never give the world a handle against him. After tonight, you, Marquis Xuanping Gu Yi, will have met your end by committing suicide out of fear of crime by burning yourself..." Du Hongzhi raised his right hand and smugly ordered, "Zong Cang, Zong Luo, I've wronged you two inner-realm experts by having you conceal your identities by my side for all these years. Tonight, you may let loose. His Highness the Fourth Prince has ordered that the traitorous Gu family shall be executed to the last, leaving no one alive!"

The two middle-aged men cupped their fists and said in deep voices, "As you command!"

Though Gu Yi was a scholar, he was no scholar without the strength to truss a chicken. In his youth, he too had defended the frontiers and spilled his blood on the battlefield... Now, even though the imperial authority was hard to disobey and the downfall of his clan was sealed, he would never cowardly surrender to treacherous villains without a fight!

Even though his long sword had remained un-sheathed for many years, its cold gleam was no less fierce than it had been in the past.

Gu Yi thrust his sword straight at Du Hongzhi's face. Despite the interception and protection of Zong Cang and Zong Luo, the sword's glare still managed to graze Du Hongzhi's arm.

"Kill him! Kill him!" All the color drained from Du Hongzhi's face as he retreated behind a phalanx of guards, shouting in humiliated rage.

At the sound, Zong Luo instantly made his move, a short blade hurtling straight toward Gu Yi. In terms of pure martial prowess, Gu Yi was inferior to Zong Luo, but a cornered beast still fights. For a time, the two of them actually traded blows evenly.

Yet right at that moment, as if guided by some telepathic connection, Gu Yi suddenly spotted his daughter from a remote, hidden corner.

The moment their eyes met, he lost all strength to parry, allowing the short blade to pierce his waist and abdomen... He saw Gu Lingzhao staring with eyes split to the corners, wanting to rush over. Fortunately, someone behind her covered her mouth and grabbed her in a death grip...

Even in his final moments, Gu Yi was still terrified. If he fell in that direction, it would expose Gu Lingzhao to Du Hongzhi. Therefore, mustering his last breath, he hurled the sword in his hand at Du Hongzhi. The long blade was easily deflected upward by Zong Cang's hand, while Zong Luo drove his blade once more into Gu Yi's heart...

His vision was blanketed in red, the very nightmare that Gu Lingzhao could never escape day after day. With her heart feeling as though it were being stirred by a knife, she closed her eyes in agony. The hatred that had accumulated in the depths of her heart had long since warped her resolve. At any cost, she would tear those people into a thousand pieces!

---

What you think about by day, you dream about by night. Ye Jing really did dream of Gu Lingzhao, only the scene was from a long time ago.

The afternoon sun slanted in, bright and warm, making the people inside the study feel quite sleepy.

Gu Lingzhao sat upright, looking through the book in her hands with a serious expression, towering stacks of scrolls placed neatly before her.

"Zhaozhao, with weather this warm, why don't we go fishing?" Ye Jing sprawled across the desk in boredom, turning his head lazily to speak. He stared at the cinnabar mole at the outer corner of Gu Lingzhao's right eye, utterly unable to look away.

Her face was dyed a faint pink by the sunlight, inexplicably reminding Ye Jing of the phrase "peach blossoms and human faces reflecting each other."

"The day before yesterday, you said you wanted to go horseback riding; yesterday, you said you wanted to go bird-watching. Your Ninth Highness, have you actually finished reading even a single one of these books?" Even when displeased, Gu Lingzhao's tone remained soft and gentle.

Yet Ye Jing knew that only when Gu Lingzhao was truly angry would she address him as "Your Ninth Highness" in this tone.

"Alright, alright, I'll read, I'll read, won't I? Don't be angry." Ye Jing straightened his back, scooting closer to Gu Lingzhao, and said in a aggrieved tone, "It's not like I haven't read anything at all. That book you gave me last time, I memorized it ages ago."

Gu Lingzhao's eyes lit up. "Really?"

"The book you copied with your own hands, naturally, I hold it close day and night."

"You." Gu Lingzhao poked Ye Jing on the forehead with her finger. "If you applied even half of this effort you use to coax me into pleasing the Emperor, you'd suffer far fewer punishments."

Ye Jing smiled cheekily and raised his arm, attempting to pull Gu Lingzhao into an embrace, but his arms closed around empty air.

The scene before him twisted and shifted. Ye Jing's heart skipped a beat as the back of his hand brushed against the icy red-wood headboard, the bone-chilling cold instantly shattering the warmth in his heart.

Ye Jing sat up in bed and patted his face. The hour was still early, the sun had not yet risen, and outside only a faint, dim light was visible, while inside the room was shrouded in gloom, a world apart from the warm sun in his dream.

As the alcoholic haze dissipated and he recalled the events of the previous night, Ye Jing figured he must have gone mad to have mistaken that fierce assassin for Gu Lingzhao. Gu Lingzhao's delicate frame; a gust of wind could blow her away.

Make her ride the gentlest horse, and she would sway three times with every single step; let her run for less than a hundred meters, and it would scare him into a cold sweat.

If she possessed that kind of skill, she wouldn't have ended up...

Ye Jing sat quietly alone on the bed like this until the sky grew fully bright before he finally spoke to summon Murshui inside.

"Have you investigated the origin of last night's assassin?"

"Your Highness, forgive me. This subordinate has already sent men to notify the Capital Garrison, ordering them to search for suspicious individuals throughout the capital overnight. Manpower at the city gates has also been reinforced for inspections to ensure those scoundrels cannot escape."

"Mm. Find them as quickly as possible, and take them alive."

"Understood, this subordinate understands."

Ye Jing got up to change his robes, and Mushui closely followed to serve him.

"Your Highness, this subordinate has one more matter to report."

"Speak."

"Lou Changfu, the Commander of Sunan, has submitted a visiting card, stating he has an urgent matter to discuss with Your Highness."

Ye Jing fastened the collar button of his robes and frowned in puzzlement. "The Commander of Sunan? If he is not in Sunan, why is he in the capital? This subordinate has stated previously that visiting cards and greeting posts from strangers of this sort are to be refused across the board."

"Given this man's status, submitting a visiting card is against protocol and even somewhat overstepping. This subordinate originally should not have reported it. However, this Lord Lou sent people to the estate multiple times to inquire before Your Highness even returned to the capital, and secretly delivered several large chests of gold, claiming he urgently begs Your Highness to save his life. This subordinate felt this matter was fishy and worried that failing to inform Your Highness might ruin a major affair."

Ye Jing let out a cold laugh. "What capability do I possess that would make the dignified Commander of Sunan travel thousands of miles to the capital? Furthermore, I do not recall having any connection with this Lord Lou."

Mushui's expression grew complex; he opened his mouth, but no sound came out.

"If you have something to say, spit it out! Stop putting on that coy, womanish act!"

"This subordinate wouldn't dare, it's just that this subordinate recalled something." Mushui kept his head down, not daring to meet Ye Jing's eyes, and forcibly twisted the words on the tip of his tongue. "Lord Lou Changfu was once a protégé of former Chancellor Du, and back in the day, he was also part of Ye Xuan's faction. The post of Sunan Commander was not established previously; it was only after General Weiyuan died that Lou Changfu took over Sunan, and the title of Sunan Commander came into being."

chapters.title: Who Did You Say is Ill-Fated?
chapters.content:
Ye Jing remained silent for a moment, his face devoid of any emotion. Just when Mushui thought Ye Jing was bound to ignore the man, Ye Jing calmly instructed: "Very well, you make the arrangements. Since I have nothing better to do anyway, take those chests of gold and use them to pay the rations for the Northwest Army."

"......Understood."

Mushui walked out of the main courtyard with a solemn expression. Mulin walked over and patted him on the shoulder. "Brother Mushui, why the long face? Did the Prince scold you?"

"You've come at a good time. The Prince has ordered us to take those chests of gold to pay the military rations; I'll leave that task to you."

"The Prince is actually planning to go?! That Lou Changfu is no good man; General Gu Sheng died at his hands!" Mulin widened his round eyes. "Brother Mushui, didn't you mention this to the Prince?"

Mushui shook his head and sighed. "How could I possibly guess the Prince's thoughts? Besides, those matters are merely rumors. It's fine to talk about them in private, but how could I report them to the Prince as verified fact?"

There was also a primary reason Mushui spoke in ambiguities: he could not figure out which side Ye Jing was standing on. Over the years, Ye Jing's temper had grown increasingly foul, and his actions followed few conventional rules, making it hard to fathom what he actually wanted.

"Brother Mushui, Lou Changfu is the culprit behind the Sunan tragedy. This is definitely not groundless; everyone in Sunan knows about it!"

"Enough! If you have the guts, go shout it in front of the Prince. See if the Prince will allow you to finish your sentence. Mulin, I'll warn you only once: watch your language. The Gu family's charges have not been cleared, and Lou Changfu is still an imperial official of the current dynasty. The Prince has more than one band of shadow guards at his disposal; don't assume you're the only one who knows things."

"I know I was wrong," Mulin muttered, lowering his head.

"The Lou family is pressing urgently. Since the Prince has accepted their things, he will likely go pay a visit in the next couple of days."

"I know my limits and will be prudent in my words and actions."

"The Prince is entering the palace this afternoon. You must be even more cautious inside the palace, watch your mouth!"

"Understood."

The Imperial Palace, Hall of Diligent Government. As the commander-in-chief of the Northwest Army, it was Ye Jing's duty to enter the palace and report on his duties.

Ye Zhang was extremely pleased with his younger brother's performance on the battlefield over the years. Ye Jing was his biological younger brother and had been devoted to him since childhood. Seeing Ye Jing achieve success and renown, aside from the joy expected of an emperor, Ye Zhang felt an extra layer of heartfelt pride.

"A-Jing, is there anything in the capital you can't get used to? Are you satisfied with the manor the Ministry of Personnel remodeled for you?"

"Replying to Your Majesty, I am used to it all."

"In the past, I always worried you weren't steady enough in your actions, terrified you'd cause trouble everywhere. Who would have thought that in the blink of an eye, our A-Jing could also stand on his own and become the God of War of our Great Qian!"

"This subject does not dare accept such praise. Being able to share Your Majesty's worries is this subject's honor." Ye Jing spoke with reverence mixed with alienation, no longer able to display his former affectionate demeanor.

Ye Zhang looked at the younger brother who was now taller than himself, feeling a lingering melancholy in his heart. In the past, he and the Empress Dowager had been driven to headaches by Ye Jing's rebelliousness. Now, after a few years of tempering in the military camp, Ye Jing had indeed grown much steadier in every aspect. Yet he always felt that something of the living spirit was missing from Ye Jing; a person who ought to be brimming with vigor was inexplicably shrouded in an aura of desolation.

"The events of your early years; the Empress Dowager and I wronged you. You aren't young anymore, and the Empress Dowager intends to use this period to settle your marriage. The Empress Dowager has her eye on the Chancellor's eldest daughter, you..."

"Your Majesty, this subject has no intention of remarrying. After the Empress Dowager's birthday banquet, this subject plans to return to the Northwest."

"Both the Northwest and Southwest are peaceful now. Why torture yourself by going back?"

"The military camp is very good." Ye Jing's expression was stubborn, showing no intention of relenting.

Ye Zhang inwardly let out a soft sigh. Ultimately, he and the Empress Dowager owed Ye Jing far too much. "Fine, fine. Handle your own affairs as you see fit; we will not force you. We can discuss your return to the Northwest later... I still have some state affairs to attend to. Remember to go to the Feng'an Palace to pay your respects to the Empress Dowager; she has been talking about you since early this morning."

"Yes."

Walking from the Hall of Diligent Government to the Feng'an Palace required passing through the Imperial Garden. From a distance, Ye Jing spotted the lively bustle within the garden. A crowd of gorgeously dressed, young, and pretty maidens wore brightly colored, magnificent robes that made the flowers in the garden pale in comparison.

"Your Highness, ahead is the banquet hosted by the Empress, attended entirely by unmarried young ladies from various estates," Mulin reported, his speed in gathering intelligence always prompt. "However, the Empress has not yet arrived."

Ye Jing frowned. Since the Empress was not there, he had no need to go forward and pay respects; he might as well take a detour and change routes to the Feng'an Palace. Yet, perhaps due to the sharp hearing of a martial artist, before Ye Jing could turn around, a series of grating remarks slammed right into his steps.

"Miss Du is intelligent and pure of heart, talented and beautiful in every way; she clearly has a naturally noble destiny. How could that ill-fated Gu woman ever compare?"

"Back then, everyone said the Gu woman looked good, but I never saw it. Since I was young, I've felt that Miss Du's appearance is the true, undisputed best in the capital."

"You girls stop talking nonsense. Do not gossip about the deceased." Though Du Yufu was nominally stopping them, the smile on her face did not lessen by even half. Her father currently held an unshakable position at court, and among the noble young ladies, she naturally received treatment akin to the stars surrounding the moon.

"Miss Du is right. Someone who died without a burial place isn't worth our effort. Thinking about it, she was quite pitiful, too; I heard the Gu woman was bitten to death alive by wild beasts, her bones torn apart and eaten piece by piece."

"Don't you doubt it, this was divined by Daoist Priest Chai. He said the Gu woman died an extremely miserable death, all four limbs severed, bleeding to death!"

The enmity between Du Yufu and Gu Lingzhao was an open secret within the circle of aristocratic daughters. If they wanted to butter up to Du Yufu, they naturally had to say what Du Yufu liked to hear. Thus, slandering Gu Lingzhao became a mandatory staple of every banquet and gathering. The more miserably they described Gu Lingzhao, the happier Du Yufu became, and the more benefits they could reap. Gradually, nobody observed any boundaries, and the excessive remarks grew more and more frequent.

"What are you all talking about?" A low, chilling voice rang out, scaring the crowd into instantly falling silent.

Ye Jing stepped out from behind the lush foliage and stood before the crowd, a pair of eyes carrying a terrifying murderous aura, as if he might draw his sword and kill someone at any second.

"This King is asking you a question. Who is the person you were just talking about?!"

The girls, who had just been wearing flattering smiles, instantly turned pale with fright, lowering their heads and not daring to make a single sound.

Ye Jing had never been a magnanimous or lenient person. When he chose to be serious, even if the King of Heaven himself were present, there would still be no way to deal with him.

"Whose life did you say was ill-fated? Who was bitten to death alive by wild beasts?" Ye Jing walked step by step toward the three women who had been speaking, the grimness in his eyes akin to an Asura from hell, scaring two of them so badly their legs turned weak and they dropped to their knees on the ground.

"Greetings, Prince Rong." The surrounding noble daughters finally snapped to their senses and hurriedly stepped forward to bow to Ye Jing.

"May Your Highness Prince Rong appease your wrath. These three young ladies are young and suffered a momentary lapse in speech; it truly was against protocol. Yufu has known Your Highness for many years and knows Your Highness possesses a broad mind. I hope Your Highness will consider that it was an unintentional mistake and forgive them this once. Yufu is willing to bear the blame on behalf of the three of them." Du Yufu assumed a posture of deep righteousness, bowing deeply before Ye Jing.

The gazes of the girls behind her were filled with the relief of seeing a savior, while they simultaneously let out breaths of relief. That was Du Yufu, the eldest daughter of the Chancellor's estate; even Prince Jing's consort had to yield to her by three points. Now, with the Empress Dowager intending to have her marry into Prince Rong's estate, no matter how one looked at it, Prince Rong could not possibly refuse to give her face.

Ye Jing coldly glanced at Du Yufu. The chill in that gaze made Du Yufu's scalp prickle, and she suddenly regretted standing up for these women.

"Since you can speak, then this King will ask you: was the Gu woman they were just talking about Gu Lingzhao?"

"This..." Du Yufu knelt on the ground, struck momentarily speechless. She had not expected Ye Jing to ask so directly, nor had she anticipated that Ye Jing would completely refuse to save face for her. Living too long amidst days of blooming flowers and flourishing brocades had made Du Yufu forget what it felt like to be inferior to others.

"Answer me!"

"......Yes."

chapters.title: The Crime of Disrespect
chapters.content:
Ye Jing raised his head, stood in the Imperial Garden, and looked around. His teeth were chattering uncontrollably, and his rage was on the verge of making him lose his mind.

If these people dared to be so presumptuous right here in the imperial palace, what kind of faces did they put on in ordinary times? Even if the Gu family had fallen into disgrace, even if he and Gu Lingzhao had torn off all pretense of civility and grown to loathe the sight of each other, she was still Gu Lingzhao! He didn't even dare to dwell on her name too much; how dared these people speak of her like this!

"Who on earth is the Daoist Master Chaigong?"

"This... Daoist Master Chaigong is an... an enlightened master of the Chidou Temple."

"Your Highness, this Chaigong..." Mulin didn't even finish his sentence before he suddenly noticed that Ye Jing's eyes were completely bloodshot. Beneath his gaze lurked a tempest of raging waves, sending an inexplicable shudder through Mulin's heart.

"Speak!"

"If this subordinate remembers correctly, it was precisely this Daoist Master Chaigong who once boasted in the Princess Pingyao's estate that he would feed flowers with human blood."

Ye Jing's gaze froze. He fell silent for a long moment, then let out a soft breath and muttered to himself, "I thought he was some sort of formidable expert; turns out it's just him. To think he's still alive... His words hold no weight."

"When we return, invite this 'master' into the Prince Rong's Manor. I shall personally discuss the Dao with him." The hidden malice in Ye Jing's words made the guards of Prince Rong's Manor feel a chill in their hearts.

"These three committed the offense of insubordination and deserve capital punishment. Does Miss Du insist on taking the blame for them?"

All the color drained from Du Yufu's face. She merely glanced up at Ye Jing once before instantly lowering her head, her fingers unconsciously twisting the fabric of her dress, not daring to utter another half-syllable. No matter how bold Du Yufu usually was, cold sweat could not help but break out all over her body at this moment; the look the man was giving her truly did not resemble how one looked at a living person.

Upon hearing this, the three women grew panicked to the extreme, kowtowing and begging for mercy, "Have mercy, Prince Rong! We'll never dare do it again! Your Highness, have mercy!"

"Since you constantly have your tragic fates hanging on your lips, this Prince shall grant your wish. Mushui, Mulin!"

"Here!"

"Take these three to the imperial prison and execute them!"

At this time, the other young ladies present finally realized the gravity of the situation and knelt down one after another, crying out, "Your Highness, calm your anger!"

"Spare us, Prince Rong! Miss Du, please save us!" Their hairpins utterly disheveled and losing their minds with panic, the three cried out, "These words were all taught to us by people from your estate!"

"Shameless slanders! I kindly saved you, how can you have the face to bite back? Your Highness, please examine the truth, Yufu holds absolutely no disrespect toward the Princess Consort Rong."

Just then, the Empress's procession was approaching from another path. Behind the Empress, resplendent in phoenix crown and magnificent robes, followed the Princess Consort Jing, whose attire was rather unassuming.

"I heard that the Third Prince had a dispute with the Ninth Prince last night? Logically speaking, the Third Prince has always treated others with kindness and generosity, so why would he lose his temper with his own younger brother?"

Mu Yunyao responded with a faint smile, "It was merely a few idle words between brothers, hardly a dispute."

"As his wife, you ought to counsel him more often. The Ninth Prince has spent years stationed in the Northwest; the border is bitter and cold, nothing like the comfort and ease of the capital. You must understand that the Ninth Prince is now a meritorious subject of Great Qian, someone who has truly shed blood on the battlefield. We idlers living in the lap of luxury simply cannot afford to provoke such a wrath."

Mu Yunyao lowered her head and replied, "Your Imperial Sister-in-law speaks wisely, this concubine will keep it in mind."

The Empress was very satisfied with Mu Yunyao's submissiveness. She nodded and finally managed a slight smile.

"This Palace is only doing this for the Third Prince's own good... What is that noise?"

This lecture was ultimately interrupted by the wails of ghosts and howls of wolves echoing from not far away.

Upon entering the Imperial Garden, the Empress's entourage was directly stunned into wide-eyed shock by the scene before them.

A group of aristocratic young ladies were kneeling on the ground. The three at the front had disheveled hair and foreheads stained bright red with blood, and the crying and shouting originated precisely from these three.

"Empress Dowager, Empress, save us! Prince Rong is going to kill us." The moment they saw the Empress appear, the three of them acted as if they had seen a savior deity. Terrified to the point of losing their strength, they could only frantically crawl toward the direction of the Empress.

The Empress sternly rebuked, "What kind of composure is this! What on earth is going on here!"

"Greetings, Imperial Sister-in-law."

"Ninth Younger Brother, what is this... These are all women from official households in the capital. Did they somehow offend you?" The Empress could not fathom for the life of her how these few delicate women could have provoked Ye Jing.

With a rigid expression, Ye Jing said evenly, "They showed disrespect to my Princess Consort, saying she was ill-fated and lacked blessing, destined to die a wretched death. Imperial Sister-in-law, judge the matter for me; should I not have dealt with them?"

"This..." The Empress was startled at first, inwardly blaming these few for running their mouths without thinking, daring to speak ill of the Gu woman right to Ye Jing's face. No matter how wretched the Gu woman was, she currently still bore the title of Princess Consort Rong; wasn't this tantamount to slapping Prince Rong across the face?

"Then how does Ninth Younger Brother intend to deal with them?"

"The crime of disrespect calls for execution." The few breezy words falling from Ye Jing's lips caused the Empress's expression to stiffen slightly.

"Ninth Younger Brother, these young maids are still of tender years. Even if they are in the wrong, their crimes do not warrant death. Why not punish them by sending them back to be confined and copy the Classic of Filial Piety for Women a hundred times as a warning? What do you think?"

Upon hearing this, wild joy burst forth in the eyes of the three women. Yet before they even had time to express their gratitude, they heard Prince Rong state bluntly, "No, that's too light. At the very least, their tongues should be cut out."

"......"

A wave of stifling oppression instantly seized the Empress's chest. She thought to herself: wasn't it a fact that the Gu woman hadn't even reached twenty when she died without a complete corpse, and that she was ill-fated and lacked blessings? Besides, the person died at his own hands, not murdered by others; what was the need to make such a grand fuss? These few were invited by her into the palace as banquet guests, yet execution was the first word out of his mouth. Did he still hold her, the Empress, in any regard at all?

"Prince Rong, spare us! We truly know we were wrong, don't cut out our tongues, I beg you!"

"Ninth Younger Brother, you... The Empress Dowager's birthday is fast approaching, it is not fitting to see blood in the palace." To prevent Ye Jing from uttering words about dragging people outside the palace walls in the next second, the Empress continued rapidly, "The Empress Dowager's benevolent name is far and wide, she detests killings above all else. In consideration of the Empress Dowager's benevolent heart of chanting scriptures and practicing vegetarianism day in and day out, please pardon these three maidens. Princess Consort Jing, don't you agree?"

The Empress exchanged a glance with Mu Yunyao at her side, signaling her to stop watching the fun and quickly think of a solution.

A flash of indifference crossed Mu Yunyao's eyes, but she still spoke to persuade him, "Prince Rong, these few did indeed commit the crime of disrespect, but Sister Azhao is not a narrow-minded person who would hold grudges. If she knew that someone merely gossiped behind her back and was to have her tongue cut out as a result, presumably her heart would not feel at ease either. How about forty slaps across the mouth and confinement for three months? How does Prince Rong find that?"

Ye Jing gave Mu Yunyao a deep look before shifting his gaze back to the three shivering women.

"Forty slaps across the mouth. Also, a father's sin if his child is untaught. Summon your fathers to the Prince Rong's Manor; this Prince wants to personally ask how they educate their children!"

Inwardly rolling her eyes, the Empress suppressed the anger in her heart and raised a hand, whereupon people immediately stepped forward to swiftly drag the three away.

chapters.title: Only Marrying Her in This Lifetime
chapters.content:
Ye Jing turned around and bowed to the Empress. "Having disturbed Imperial Sister-in-law's leisure today, I hope Your Highness will forgive me. It is inconvenient for this younger brother to linger, so I shall take my leave first."

Before leaving, Ye Jing glanced toward Du Yufu's direction. That single glance alone made Du Yufu's heart thump wildly; though her knees had gone numb from kneeling, her desire for Ye Jing actually deepened by several folds.

The Empress's leisure had indeed been ruined. After casually exchanging a few perfunctory remarks, she dismissed the company. Once these aristocratic young ladies had departed, the Empress looked at the meek-looking Mu Yunyao and sighed, for once out of genuine sincerity, "I finally understand the Third Prince now. It's a pity Mother and the Emperor praised the Ninth to the skies; I thought he had made some tremendous progress, but in the end, isn't he still this lunatic? Advise the Third Prince to cross paths with him less often these days. If you truly lock horns with him, you'll only be the ones who suffer."

"Your Highness's instructions, Yunyao has noted them down."

Following this farce, Ye Jing only sat for a brief while in the Feng'an Palace before it was time for the Empress Dowager to attend to her Buddhist devotions.

Seeing that Ye Jing could muster no interest in her words, the Empress Dowager did not dare nag him any further. Having managed with great difficulty to call him back from the borderlands, she was genuinely afraid that if Ye Jing grew impatient, he would run back to the Northwest and stay there for another five or six years.

Leaving the Feng'an Palace alongside Ye Jing was Liang Zheng, who had already endured instructions there for quite some time.

"You're shrewd, dragging it out until now to arrive. You have no idea; just a moment ago, the Aunt was practically on the verge of having people hold me down to get married." Walking outside the Feng'an Palace, Liang Zheng still felt lingering fear from the mental torture he had just endured.

"When did you return? Why wasn't there a single whisper of news?"

"I came back to celebrate the Aunt's birthday, just arrived as well. In Jiangdong Prefecture, I'm just an idle person, naturally incomparable to the God of War's grand presence." Liang Zheng was a few years older than Ye Jing. When Ye Jing first returned to the capital years ago, Liang Zheng had spent most of the time leading him around to become acquainted with various figures in the capital. Though the two were cousins, their bond was likely several degrees closer than that of biological brothers.

"The Aunt just said it herself: the marriage of the two of us is the thorn in her side. This time she has made up her mind; she won't let us leave the capital unless she plays matchmaker and gets us married."

Ye Jing furrowed his brows tightly, walking forward without a word.

"Hey, God of War, why don't you just follow the Aunt's wishes this once, take a wife to fulfill her wishes, and let her off my back?"

"I will not remarry." Ye Jing answered crisply.

"You..." Liang Zheng narrowed his eyes, hesitating, "Do you not want to marry now, or do you not plan on marrying at all in the future?"

"Never."

Liang Zheng gasped in shock. "Are you serious? Aren't you afraid that you won't have descendants in the future, that you'll be left all alone, helpless and destitute in your old age... Don't glare at me, those were the Aunt's exact words just now."

"Cousin, you'd better worry more about yourself. I will never reach the day of being helpless and destitute."

Liang Zheng curled his lips, a flash of inspiration suddenly crossing his mind. "Could it be that you already have a child outside? Or perhaps you already have a secret mistress?"

Ye Jing halted his steps as if he had heard something utterly preposterous, his handsome face twisting into a rare grimace.

"Young Master Liang shouldn't project his own ways onto others. Instead of gossiping here, why don't you go look for your former confidantes? You might even find some pleasant surprises."

"Alright, alright, let's drop it, it was my slip of the tongue. Please, Elder, be magnanimous and don't take it to heart. How about I treat you to listen to some music at the Yihong Pavilion? What do you say?"

"Not going."

"In the past you had scruples, worried about the Gu family's opinions. What is there to be afraid of now? You don't even dare go listen to music?" Liang Zheng was the legitimate eldest son of his household and an imperial relative to boot, his personality spoiled since childhood, always daring to speak his mind. "With you neither remarrying nor even willing to visit a brothel, could it be..."

"Enough!"

Stunned for a moment, Liang Zheng suddenly straightened up, leaned in close to him, and said, "You wouldn't still be thinking of Gu Lingzhao, would you..."

"No. But I swore an oath back then: in this lifetime, I will only marry her."

"And you call that not thinking of her?" Liang Zheng was almost choked to death by Ye Jing's logic. "I say, are you playing a joke on me? Didn't you used to detest talk of Buddhas, Daoists, and ghosts and gods the most? Are you planning to never marry for the rest of your life simply because of an oath you once made? So many years have passed, the Gu family's eldest young miss has probably already been reincarnated, where would she have the spare time to watch whether you fulfill your oath or not..."

Ye Jing strode even faster, nearly leaving Liang Zheng behind.

"Hey, wait up!"

Liang Zheng trotted to catch up, looked around left and right, and confirming there were no outsiders nearby, lowered his voice to ask, "Actually, I've always had a question: what on earth happened back then? Why did the Prince Consort Jing's Estate bite down so hard and insist that you harmed Gu Lingzhao? Over the years, the Prince Consort Jing's Estate hasn't spared any effort in spreading your infamous reputation of killing your wife."

"I know."

"Then aren't you planning to clear your name? Even down in Jiangdong Prefecture, I've heard your infamy."

Hearing this, Ye Jing replied indifferently, "I never relied on a good reputation to live anyway. It's painless and harmless, why bother caring? Besides... the insults aren't wrong..."

In broad daylight, looking up meant facing the glaring sun. Ye Jing narrowed his eyes; the surroundings were scorching hot, yet he could not feel a shred of warmth in his heart.

The final sentence was spoken so lightly that Liang Zheng failed to catch it clearly for a moment. "What?"

"Nothing." Ye Jing deflected the topic, looked at Liang Zheng, and said, "You're two years older than me; it's indeed time to ask the Empress Dowager to betroth you to someone."

"Gods forbid, Jiangdong Prefecture hasn't been peaceful lately, I must hurry back."

"Jiangdong Prefecture doesn't border the frontier. Does anyone actually dare start an internal rebellion?"

"It's those pugilists. Jiangdong Prefecture neighbors Nanyuan, and Nanyuan City happens to be the stronghold of the South Xiao Tower. Your Highness must have heard of this number-one assassination organization in the pugilistic world, right?"

"I know of it."

"Recently, rumors have spread that the master of the South Xiao Tower suffered a deviation in his cultivation and was injured. Right now, undercurrents are surging through the entire martial arts world, and I must go back to guard my Jiangdong Prefecture. Over the years, the South Xiao Tower has grown far too arrogant, repeatedly daring to make moves against imperial officials."

"Desperadoes have always been like this, taking money to perform tasks and eliminating disasters for others. Assassins have no tomorrow in their eyes, naturally acting without any scruples." Ye Jing looked into the distance, his voice floating lightly so that no emotion could be discerned.

---

"Old Hei, do you see a shred of demure maidenly grace in me?" Qingyu, a desperado, had somehow managed to unearth a long gown of fine silk, stuck a few golden hairpins in her hair, and was pacing back and forth in the courtyard with her hands folded.

Sitting on a stone stool, Old Hei rubbed his nose and said somewhat awkwardly, "Qingyu, this dress looks nice indeed, but the strides you take are wider than a man's, and with that martial hero's aura all over you, no matter how you look, you don't resemble a delicate woman."

"What are you two doing?" Gu Lingzhao suddenly appeared in the front courtyard, causing the two to hastily stand straight and bow in greeting.

"Master!"

"Pavilion Master!"

"Qingyu, what are you trying to do?"

"I am... I was..."

"Reporting to Pavilion Master, we recently learned that the Lou estate is scouring everywhere for beauties. Uh, so Qingyu intended to see if she could use this method to sneak inside."

"Scouring for beauties?"

chapters.title: Distinguished Guest at the Lou Mansion
chapters.content:
"That's right! An old man of his age pulling such disgusting stunts!"

Old Hei added, "It's not just women, but all kinds of rare treasures. Although Lou Changfu has been hiding like a turtle in its shell lately and daring not to step outside, the Lou mansion has been quite active. My subordinates suspect he's mostly trying to grease palms and find a patron here in the capital."

"Everyone knows that man surnamed Lou committed every atrocity in Southern Jiangsu, forcing women and seizing property. It's almost certain he'll relapse into his old evil ways now that he's in the capital. Once I go there, see if I don't stab him three times and run him through!"

Gu Lingzhao looked at Qingyu once again, her expression pensive, her brows slightly furrowed.

"Master, why are you looking at me like that?"

"Although this outfit is gorgeous, it's not suitable for this kind of work, and this matter shouldn't be handled by you. Heizhou, take my token and find a human trafficker named Chao Wu on Saiyong Street. He is a man of the Vermilion Pavilion. Entrust this matter to his arrangements and tell him that within three days, I want to step foot into the Lou mansion."

"Understood, Pavilion Master!"

"Ah? Master, do you mean you are going to the Lou mansion in person? How... how can you let yourself do such a thing! Lou Changfu's intentions are malicious, not to mention that the King of Hell is easy to deal with, but the little demons are hard to handle. Who knows what kind of mess that mansion is in? What if you are humiliated by the people in the Lou mansion?! And that Lou Changfu..." Some words Qingyu simply couldn't bring herself to say. "Anyway, this is not a good plan."

"For the sake of missions in the past, what methods haven't I used?" Gu Lingzhao looked at Heizhou and said solemnly, "Heizhou, I want a seamless identity, one that can withstand deep scrutiny at the very least."

"This subordinate understands."

Qingyu's first reaction was that she couldn't accept it. How could she let her cold, holy master sell her looks! But upon second thought, her master was indeed different from her. Every movement of Gu Lingzhao lacked the slightest trace of vulgarity. When she sat quietly there on ordinary days, she looked very much like a young lady from a prestigious family.

Only when she held swords and blades could people suddenly remember that this person was actually a top-tier assassin of the South Xiao Tower.

Thinking of her master's appearance, Qingyu figured that, let alone sneaking into the Lou mansion, even if the old emperor himself came, he would inevitably be captivated.

"Master, the Lou family has invited quite a few martial arts experts to bolster their forces recently. Many registered Jianghu experts are currently staying at the Lou mansion."

"If even the Lou family is something to be feared..." Gu Lingzhao chuckled softly, leaving the rest unsaid. If she couldn't even kill Lou Changfu, then she needn't bother plotting revenge against Prime Minister Du anymore. Harming others and herself, she might as well just die right there in the Lou mansion and be done with it.

"Let me see just how much the Lou family is willing to pay to save this life of his."

Gu Lingzhao patted Qingyu on the shoulder. She truly didn't think killing Lou Changfu was much of a difficult task. If she left traces, so be it; it didn't matter if people found out who the killer was. After all, South Xiao Tower was the top assassination organization in the Jianghu, always taking money and ignoring everything else. With the Lou brothers committing countless crimes over the years, who would ever attribute South Xiao Tower's handiwork to the Gu family, which had been wiped out years ago?

Compared to the top dignitaries in the capital, the Lou family's capital residence did not look conspicuous on the outside, but the inside was a completely different world: pavilions, towers, trees, and running water. Every single furnishing and arrangement that displayed luxury was present in this mansion, looking nothing like a temporary refuge for fleeing refugees.

The Lou mansion steward stood under the corridor, his triangular eyes narrowed. Several brightly dressed women stood in a row before him, waiting for his reprimand.

"The master is banqueting a distinguished guest in the mansion today. The few of you better remember your rules well. The slightest slip-up that displeases the distinguished guest; forget about you lot, even this old life of mine will have to be paid along with it."

"This maid understands."

The Lou steward gave a satisfied "Hmph." These beauties before him were women of exceptional appearance whom he had spent a tremendous amount of effort and careful selection to find.

The steward walked up to one of them and asked, "Nianyue?"

"Steward."

The summoned woman curtsied to the Lou steward. The Lou steward stared at Nianyue's face, unable to tear his eyes away. Even though he had seen her for several days, every time he still felt a sense of astonishment in his heart. The Lou steward thought to himself that he had supposed he had seen all the beauties in Southern Jiangsu, yet he never expected such peerless grace to exist in this world.

"Among the few of you, I have the highest hopes for you. This opportunity to rise to the skies in a single bound is right before your eyes."

"Nianyue will forever engrave the kindness of Steward's cultivation in her heart."

"Hmph, your mouth is certainly sweet. No rush, there is an even luckier matter. Do you know who the distinguished guest in the mansion is today?"

Nianyue's eyelashes fluttered slightly as she raised her eyes to look at the Lou steward, waiting for his next sentence.

"Hahahaha, heaven's secrets must not be leaked. Continue practicing your dance and don't let up."

---

"His Highness Prince Rong's grand presence truly brings great brilliance to my humble dwelling. This official has prepared a meager batch of wine, and hopes Your Highness will not disdain it."

"Lord Lou is too polite. The guard deployment in your prefectural mansion is no less impressive than that of my own prince's manor."

Lou Changfu smiled bitterly. "Your Highness flatters this official. This official is merely taking measures out of helplessness. Please take the seat of honor, Your Highness."

Ye Jing sat in the main seat, with his two guards, Muxiu and Mulin, standing solemnly behind him, projecting an aura that put a certain amount of pressure on Lou Changfu.

"I have spent a long time in the military camps and do not understand the twisting and turning language of officialdom. Lord Lou may speak your mind directly."

Lou Changfu's face-changing speed was extremely fast. One moment he was all smiles, but the moment he took his seat, he instantly burst into tears.

"Your Highness does not know this, but this official has served in Southern Jiangsu for many years. While I dare not claim to have achieved great administrative accomplishments, these years have nonetheless been marked by favorable weather, smooth governance, and harmonious people." As Lou Changfu spoke, he began wiping away tears again, looking as though he had suffered a grievance of monstrous proportions.

Ye Jing inwardly cursed him for being disgusting, but he still suppressed his impatience, cleared his throat, and asked, "Lord Lou need not grieve. If you have encountered any injustice, you may state it clearly to me, and I will naturally preside over the matter for Lord Lou."

"If Your Highness can save this official's life this time, this official is willing to shed blood and smash brains for Your Highness in the future, refusing to shirk even in death!"

Ye Jing furrowed his brow slightly and said, "First explain the matter clearly."

"Someone wants this official's life! Your Highness may not know, but over the past three years, the chief officials who participated in the case of Gu Sheng have continuously suffered accidents. Some suddenly died of poisoning in their mansions, others were assassinated while outside, and even worse, some were hacked to death right inside their own mansions by intruders who forced their way in... This official had to flee in panic to the capital just to barely preserve his life for the time being."

Upon hearing the name "Gu Sheng," Ye Jing immediately perged up, but his expression remained impassive as he asked with feigned indifference, "Oh? Is someone truly so frantic?"

"More than just frantic, they are completely lawless! My own younger brother was beheaded right outside the capital city gates. To commit murder so brazenly right under the emperor's nose shows that the ringleader holds His Majesty in absolute disregard!"

chapters.title: Reunion
chapters.content:
Ye Jing asked casually, "Does Lord Lou already have someone in mind whom you suspect?"

"This... this official dares not say."

"If you don't want to say it, then forget it. I am not particularly interested either."

"Ah?" Lou Changfu hadn't expected Ye Jing to play completely outside the rules, and a stunned expression remained frozen on his face.

"Your Highness, please calm your anger. It is not that this official is intentionally withholding the punchline, but rather that this matter is of grave importance. The only commonality among these officials who died violent deaths is that every single one of them participated in the case of the traitor Gu Sheng. Therefore, this official guesses that this matter is definitely inseparable from the Gu family."

Ye Jing's gaze flickered, but his tone became even gentler as he asked, "The Gu family? The Marquis of Xuanping's household, the Gu family?"

"Precisely."

"Lord Lou, I am very curious to know one thing: back then, what on earth did you use as evidence to sentence Gu Sheng to death?"

"This... Gu Sheng acted under the instructions of the Marquis of Xuanping to collude with enemy nations. Th-this is ironclad evidence... We officials definitely made our judgment in accordance with the law." Lou Changfu raised his sleeve to wipe his face, this time to wipe away the sweat on his forehead. Ye Jing's attitude was somewhat inconsistent with what Lou Changfu had anticipated, coupled with his aggressive tone, leaving Lou Changfu momentarily unsure whether he should continue telling his story.

"Today, this official merely came to beg Your Highness for a personal favor and did not intend to touch upon official business. Hahahaha, in all the talking, I actually forgot a major event. Drinking wine alone at a banquet is rather uninteresting, so this official has specially prepared a performance for mere amusement, and hopes Your Highness will grant us the honor of watching." Lou Changfu smiled obsequiously and clapped his hands. Immediately, eight beautifully dressed women walked slowly in from behind the screens on both sides.

The music of strings and flutes sounded, and several beauties danced to the rhythm, their postures graceful and extremely eye-catching.

Ye Jing had no interest in the beauties before him, not sparing them even half a glance, but instead turned his head and stared darkly at Lou Changfu.

"Lord Lou, you beat around the bush and point the finger at the Gu family, yet everyone in the world knows that there is no one left in the Gu family. Where do you expect me to go to protect you?! To the netherworld?!"

Lou Changfu stood up and knelt before Ye Jing. At that moment, the music stopped abruptly, and the dancing women also knelt down in unison.

"Your Highness, please calm your anger! Although the chief criminal of the Gu family is dead, remnants still survive, and this faction has already fled into the capital. The motives of the person behind them are probably not limited to just this official's life alone!"

"You mean to say that these remnants will also implicate me?"

"A stray dog inevitably bites wildly at random. After all, Your Highness had some entanglements with the Gu family; the enemy is in the shadows, and one cannot afford not to be on guard!"

Ye Jing picked up the wine cup on the table and was about to smash it down when he suddenly heard Mulin behind him let out a startled "Hiss." Already in a foul mood, Ye Jing glared at Mulin as a warning, then turned his head back, his gaze sweeping precisely toward the hall below.

A familiar face came into view, giving him no time for preparation, like a fierce wind howling through mountain ridges, or an avalanche instantly striking a snowy alpine peak.

Ye Jing only felt his heart thump violently, as if a flash of silver light crossed his mind. In a split second, all rationality completely collapsed.

That was... Gu Lingzhao?!!

Ye Jing stood up abruptly. His movement was so fast that it knocked over the table in front of him.

Wine cups, bowls, and plates shattered upon hitting the floor with a crisp sound. Lou Changfu hadn't anticipated Ye Jing's reaction and remained momentarily blank with shock.

Yet Ye Jing could no longer care about the presence of such a person around him. His gaze was entirely captivated by the person before him; that face of his dreams and yearnings, which rarely even appeared in his dreams...

"Zhaozhao!"

Covering merely a few paces, Ye Jing walked over in a stumbling, faltering rush.

"Zhaozhao..."

Gu Lingzhao knelt below, a myriad of thoughts flashing through her mind, but in the end she could only lower her head and close her eyes in resignation.

This absurd scene before her was something she had never imagined. Who would have thought that the patron Lou Changfu had painstakingly traveled all the way to the capital to find was actually Ye Jing?

When Gu Lingzhao heard Ye Jing's voice from behind the screen, her heart shrank violently, as if coarse sand was constantly grinding against the tender flesh of her heart, and immediately her legs began to grow weak. Her very first reaction was to run! But if she wanted to bolt out of the banquet hall, she would inevitably expose herself directly before Ye Jing.

She had already tested it a few days ago at the prince's manor: her current martial arts prowess was simply no match for Ye Jing, and acting rashly would only make matters worse.

After turning it over in her mind, she had no choice but to wait quietly behind the screen and watch the developments unfold.

Clearly, the events were racing toward the worst possible path.

That voice, familiar beyond compare, rang in her ears sentence by sentence, like a venomous snake slowly winding its way up her body from the soles of her feet.

And at this moment, lowering her gaze and kneeling before the hall, listening to the sound of Ye Jing walking closer step by step, she felt as though the venomous snake had finally crawled up to her face, flicking its tongue and baring its fangs, preparing for the fatal strike.

"His Highness Prince Rong? What is the meaning of this?" Lou Changfu asked untimely, but failed to draw even a sliver of Ye Jing's attention.

At this moment, he only had Gu Lingzhao's figure in his eyes; he couldn't hear any other sounds at all.

Ye Jing walked step by step up to Gu Lingzhao, bent down to grab her wrist, and without waiting for her reaction, pulled her straight up.

"Why are you here?"

"Look at me!"

Gu Lingzhao was forced to raise her gaze, the two of them locking eyes. The woman's eyes were full of strangeness and timidity, while beneath the man's pool-like dark eyes seemed to be suppressed a fury of a myriad tons.

The sound of a thumping heartbeat echoed in her ears, though it was impossible to tell whose heart had lost control.

"Since you are still alive, why didn't you come looking for me? Where have you been all these years? Why wasn't there the slightest bit of news! Everyone thought you were dead!"

The more Ye Jing spoke, the more agitated he became, his oppressive aura washing over her like a tidal wave, as if he might choke her neck and snap the life out of her at the next moment.

Gu Lingzhao instinctively took a step back, widening the distance between them. Naturally, she didn't understand where his anger came from. He wasn't the one who had been thoroughly deceived, nor was it his entire family that had suffered a tragic annihilation. Was he actually angry that this face was an eyesore to him?

"May Your Highness calm your anger."

Bearing in mind her identity as Nianyue, Gu Lingzhao tried to put on an act, but alas, the strength in the man's grip was too heavy, pulling her so forcefully that she couldn't even stay kneeling.

"You are not allowed to kneel!" Ye Jing gripped her wrist tightly, his eyes filled with an unspeakable possessive obsession.

"This maid's name is Nianyue. I have never met Your Highness before. Could you have mistaken me for someone else..."

Gu Lingzhao explained in a soft, gentle voice. She wasn't entirely lying either; how could the Gu family produce a vicious person who stopped at nothing and slaughtered without blinking?

Time seemed to freeze; there was not the slightest sound in the surroundings. Gu Lingzhao could feel Ye Jing's icy fingers gently brushing across the outer corner of her eye.

That patch of skin was smooth and fair, without the slightest flaw, and certainly lacked the cinnabar mole familiar to Ye Jing.

Ye Jing's breathing suddenly grew heavy, his fingertips almost rubbing that patch of skin until it turned red...

"What is your name?" Ye Jing asked again.

"This maid's name is Nianyue."

"Good." Ye Jing acknowledged, raising his gaze once more. His expression had returned to calm, yet his hand grasping Gu Lingzhao still showed no sign of letting go.

chapters.title: This Person, I Want Her
chapters.content:
"Lord Lou, I want this dancing girl."

Gu Lingzhao's body stiffened, and for a fleeting second, she had the urge to fight Ye Jing to the death.

"These dancing girls were all painstakingly sought out by your humble official; their backgrounds are utterly spotless. If she manages to catch Your Highness's eye, it is entirely your humble official's good fortune."

"Are you willing to follow me back to my estate?"

Gu Lingzhao took a deep breath, finally gathering the courage to look up into Ye Jing's eyes.

Although this man's tone could be considered mild, the blood-soaked glint in his eyes hardly suggested he was asking for her opinion.

"...This servant obeys Your Highness's command."

"Your humble official congratulates Your Highness on obtaining such an exquisite beauty!"

Ye Jing's gaze remained fixed entirely on Gu Lingzhao, not sparing Lou Changfu even half a glance.

Yet Lou Changfu, believing the time was ripe, once again prostrated himself flat on the ground and said loudly, "The remnants of the Gu family still hold roots in the capital, but with Your Highness's support, this humble official is certain to wipe them out completely and slaughter every last one of them within ten days."

Mushui and Mulin exchanged glances, each seeing a trace of bizarre sentiment in the other's eyes.

Lou Changfu kept spewing "Gu family remnants" and demanding slaughter, while standing right before them was a woman who looked almost identical to Gu Lingzhao.

Though Mushui and Mulin dared not claim to be great saints, a strange sense of moral betrayal welled up in their hearts at that moment.

The former Gu Lingzhao had never treated any of them unfairly...

Ye Jing finally cast a sideways glance. His eyes were like the water of a freezing abyss, utterly devoid of warmth: "According to Lord Lou, where exactly do the roots of these remnants lie?"

If Lou Changfu understood Ye Jing well enough, he should have heard the hidden danger beneath Ye Jing's words; or, if he had looked up then and seen Ye Jing's reddened eyes, he surely would have sensed something amiss.

"The Gu family's roots lie precisely with Prince Jing! Without Prince Jing's assistance, how would those Gu family criminals dare to murder court officials? Such lawless crimes should, by law, be punished by death by a thousand cuts."

The moment the two words "Prince Jing" were uttered, the courtyard instantly plunged into silence.

Gu Lingzhao's killing intent rushed straight up from the top of her head.

If not for Ye Jing's presence, she would have sliced him into pieces herself first!

"Your Royal Highness Prince Rong, this humble official is by no means fabricating this out of nowhere. If Your Majesty can issue an imperial edict to search Prince Jing's estate, this humble official dares to wager his head that he will uncover evidence of Prince Jing's dealings with the Gu family remnants!"

Hearing Lou Changfu's reckless remarks, Gu Lingzhao could no longer restrain herself. Her left hand twitched slightly, and a silver needle materialized between her fingertips out of thin air.

Right now, everyone's attention was focused on Lou Changfu. Standing right beside Ye Jing, if she took the risk, she might not be discovered.

She could not afford to throw her own life away only to let Lou Changfu continue living comfortably in this world.

"Lord Lou, you have been away from the capital for a long time, so it is normal for you to be unaware of certain matters," Ye Jing spoke faintly, breaking the silence.

"Although Prince Jing's maternal family bears the surname Gu, they are only distant relatives of the Marquis of Xuanping beyond the fifth degree of mourning. If we speak of closeness, the person closest to the Gu family..." Ye Jing paused, continuing word by word, "...is actually this prince."

"Your Highness, you..." Fear suddenly surfaced in Lou Changfu's eyes.

Prince Rong was the Marquis of Xuanping's own son-in-law! How could he have forgotten this detail! Or rather, it wasn't that he had forgotten, but rather that throughout the entire Great Qian dynasty now, from high-ranking nobles down to common folk, everyone tacitly blurred this fact.

"What? Should this prince also be subjected to death by a thousand cuts?"

Lou Changfu trembled all over, prostrating himself and not daring to raise his head: "Your Highness, calm your anger! This humble official wouldn't dare..."

"Mushui, Mulin, bind him and send him to the Dali Temple. Tell Lord Chen that this man left his post without summons and attempted to sow discord and frame Prince Jing with malicious intent; he must be thoroughly interrogated. As for His Majesty, I will submit a memorial to have him detained securely first."

"Yes!" Their voices rang high, their eyes gleaming.

Faced with this sudden turn of events, Gu Lingzhao's thoughts raced through a thousand possibilities.

It wasn't that she couldn't kill Lou Changfu; it was just that after hearing his malicious intent toward Ye Tang, she suddenly felt that this man shouldn't die so easily.

Chen Huaiyang of the Dali Temple had an upright character and a good relationship with Ye Tang; letting him investigate Lou Changfu was hardly a bad thing.

As for Ye Jing... Gu Lingzhao very much wanted to know whether his face had felt even the slightest bit warm when he spoke those words just now...

Her right hand was suddenly tugged. Gu Lingzhao shuddered inwardly and hastily concealed the silver needle in her other hand.

"Come with me."

"Yes."

From the banquet hall to the gates of the Lou residence, Ye Jing tightly grasped Gu Lingzhao's hand the entire way, as if terrified she might slip away like a wisp of smoke, and refused to let go even after boarding the carriage. This effectively dashed any thoughts Gu Lingzhao had of escaping in the external chaos.

Once inside the carriage, Gu Lingzhao immediately regretted her earlier "surrender."

Trapped alone with Ye Jing in the carriage, the confined space was saturated with each other's presence. A heavy mountain seemed to press upon her chest, and the suffocating feeling made Gu Lingzhao almost want to shatter the carriage with a single palm strike.

"Where are you from, and how did you enter the Lou residence?"

"This servant is..."

"Do not refer to yourself as a servant."

Gu Lingzhao carefully weighed her words and replied, "This humble girl is a native of Yuzhou, seventeen years old this year. I was sold to the Huaxiang Pavilion since I was young. The madam of the Huaxiang Pavilion treated people reasonably well, but a few days ago, someone in the pavilion angered a high-ranking personage, and the government immediately sealed up the Huaxiang Pavilion. With nowhere else to go, we happened to encounter the Lou residence searching everywhere for women. Perhaps the Lou steward took a fancy to this humble girl's meager looks... and directly had me enter the estate to practice dancing."

"Huaxiang Pavilion... Then do you still remember where your family home is?"

"I was too young back then, I don't remember any of it."

"Is that so?" A flash of murderous intent crossed Ye Jing's eyes. "Good."

Ye Jing asked no further questions, and Gu Lingzhao certainly wouldn't speak up on her own initiative. The surroundings fell silent once more.

The interior of Prince Rong's carriage was quite spacious, yet due to Ye Jing's domineering posture, he pulled Gu Lingzhao so close that their bodies were practically pressed together. The two clung tightly to each other, leaving the rest of the space entirely empty.

A stray breeze occasionally blew past, the chill piercing through the curtains and making Gu Lingzhao's hair feel cold.

A very, very long time ago, Ye Jing had also liked to press close to her like this. Back then, her heart and eyes were entirely filled with him; the two of them were practically inseparable, clinging to each other day in and day out. Whatever she wanted to do, whatever she desired, she only had to speak, and Ye Jing would surely make it happen. Those few years of companionship were once the most wonderful time she had ever known.

Even now, Gu Lingzhao had to marvel at how impeccably well this man disguised himself. His palms and embrace were endlessly warm, and those handsome phoenix eyes always brimmed with joy and affection...

Gu Lingzhao thought and thought, yet still could not fathom Ye Jing's purpose in detaining her... Could he have recognized her as the assassin from that night? Or was he merely suspicious of her identity?

Silence enveloped the carriage. As they sat together with their robes overlapping, Gu Lingzhao absentmindedly stared at the dark silver patterns on the black cloud brocade, while Ye Jing's eyes remained unblinkingly fixed on Gu Lingzhao's face...
